data.description:
TaxTalente ist die Nr. 1 Job-Matching Plattform für Jobsuchende in der Steuerberatung.

Sie suchen eine positive berufliche Veränderung? Sie möchten den nächsten Schritt in Ihrer Karriere gehen und streben möglicherweise sogar eine Partnerschaft in einer zukunftsorientierten Kanzlei an? Sie möchten endlich wieder in einem positiven Arbeitsumfeld arbeiten, in dem Sie finanziell und persönlich wertgeschätzt werden? Sie suchen nach Tätigkeiten, die Sie auch wirklich weiterbringen?

Sofern Sie sich in mindestens einem der genannten Punkte wiederfinden, sollten Sie sich bei uns melden. Wir haben die attraktivsten Arbeitgeber der Steuerberatungsbranche in unserem Netzwerk und bringen zusammen, was zusammengehört. Grenzenlose Entwicklungschancen mit Partnermöglichkeiten, vielschichtige Tätigkeitsbereiche, Gehälter wie in der Industrie und vieles mehr – melden Sie sich bei uns und wir unterstützen Sie auf Ihrem weiteren Karriereweg!

Derzeit suchen wir nach einem Steuerberater (m/w/d) für eine unserer Partner-Kanzleien in Eberswalde

Bei Rückfragen kannst du dich gerne jederzeit (auch nach deinem Feierabend) direkt telefonisch an Herrn Becker-Koch über folgende Nummer wenden: 015901431130

Aufgaben

Wir bringen zusammen, was zusammengehört. Dabei spielt das passende Tätigkeitsprofil natürlich eine entscheidende Rolle. Bei unserer Partnerkanzlei können Sie sich Ihren Aufgabenbereich auf Basis Ihrer persönlichen Stärken und Schwächen selbst zusammenstellen.

  • Erstellung und Review von Jahresabschlüssen
  • Erstellung von Steuererklärungen für Personen- und Kapitalgesellschaften
  • Steuerliche Sonderberatungsprojekte auf Basis individueller QualifikationenB. in den Bereichen der Erbschaftsteuer oder des Umwandlungssteuerrechts
  • Begleitung von Betriebsprüfungen
  • Teamleitung und Personalverantwortung (optional)
  • Weitere individuell wählbare Tätigkeitsbereiche, die Ihnen Freude bringen

Qualifikation

Am Ende sollte es für beide Seiten passen. Deshalb wäre es gut, wenn Sie sich in den folgenden Punkten wiederfinden.

  • Kommunikative Art und Freude am Austausch mit Mandanten
  • Sorgfältige, effiziente und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise
  • Offen für eine digitale Arbeitsweise
  • Führungsverständnis und Verantwortungsbewusstsein gegenüber Mitarbeitern (optional)
  • Ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Steuerberaterexamen
  • Leidenschaft für steuerliche Themen

Benefits

Sie haben genug von 0815 Benefits, von denen Sie nicht wirklich profitieren? Dann sollten Sie einen Blick auf die nachfolgenden Benefits werfen.

  • Außerordentliche Vergütung von 90.000 € bis 130.000 € / Jahr, auf Wunsch auch Partnerperspektive
  • Flexible Gestaltung der Arbeitszeiten sowie die Option auf Home-Office
  • Nettolohnoptimierung mit monatlichen 50,00€ Sachbezugsgutscheinen
  • Umfangreiche Unterstützung bei Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen wie z.B. Fachberater Qualifikationen
  • Modernste Ausstattung mit digitalen Prozessen
  • Starker Teamzusammenhalt und regelmäßige Teamevents

Schnell, unkompliziert und effizient Ihren Traumjob finden – ein Versprechen an Sie, dass wir aufgrund unseres selektiven, breit gefächerten und deutschlandweiten Kanzleinetzwerks halten werden. lhre Vorteile mit uns auf einen Blick:

  • Sie führen keine unsinnigen Bewerbungsgespräche mehr, bei denen Sie während des Bewerbungsprozesses merken, dass es (bspw. wegen des Gehalts) sowieso nicht passt - wir klären vor Ihrem Bewerbungsgespräch all Ihre mit uns besprochenen Kriterien mit der Kanzlei ab.
  • Wir führen Ihre Gehaltsverhandlungen und kennen die Gehaltsstrukturen der Branche dabei bestens.
  • 100% Anonymität – solange Sie uns nicht das „Go“ geben und einem Kennenlernen mit Ihrem neuen potentiellen Arbeitgeber zustimmen, erfährt niemand von Ihrem Namen oder Ihren bisherigen Arbeitgebern – Ihre Ihnen wichtigen Kriterien können wir auch zunächst anonym mit unseren Partnerkanzleien klären.
  • Attraktive Kanzleien – die Kanzleien in unserem breit gefächerten Kanzleinetzwerk sind selektiv ausgewählt und heben sich klar von “normalen” Kanzleien ab (z.B. hinsichtlich der Vergütung, Benefits, Hierarchien, Digitalisierungsgrad, Ausstattung etc.).
  • Und das Beste: Unser gesamter Service ist unverbindlich und völlig kostenfrei für Sie.

data.description:
Build the Software Platform Powering Next-Generation Mobility

Apex.AI is developing the software foundation for autonomous systems, intelligent machines, and software-defined vehicles. We are looking for an early-career Software Engineer to help advance our core software platform technologies, including Apex.Grace and Apex.Ida.

This role is ideal for recent university graduates or engineers with 1–2 years of experience who are passionate about modern C++, distributed systems, middleware, developer platforms, and systems software engineering.

You will work alongside experienced engineers on high-performance middleware, runtime systems, developer tooling, and software infrastructure used in safety-critical and real-time environments. This is an opportunity to gain hands-on experience building production-quality software for automotive, robotics, aerospace, and industrial automation applications.

We are looking for engineers who enjoy solving complex technical problems, learning deeply about software systems, and building tools and platforms that other developers rely on every day.

This role is based in our Munich office.


What You’ll Do
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of core software components for Apex.AI products, particularly Apex.Grace and Apex.Ida
  • Help build software platform capabilities, middleware features, developer tooling, and runtime infrastructure
  • Support improvements in performance, reliability, scalability, and maintainability across the platform stack
  • Assist in debugging and resolving complex software and system-level issues
  • Develop automated tests, CI workflows, and engineering tooling
  • Collaborate closely with platform, product, and applications teams to deliver production-quality software
  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and software design activities
  • Learn and apply engineering best practices for modern C++ and systems software development
  • Contribute ideas and improvements to developer workflows and platform usability

What You Bring
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Robotics, or a related technical field
  • Strong foundation in software engineering and computer science fundamentals
  • Experience with modern C++ through coursework, internships, personal projects, or early professional work
  • Familiarity with Python or scripting languages
  • Experience developing software on Linux-based systems
  • Interest in distributed systems, middleware, runtime systems, or embedded software
  • Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills
  • Familiarity with Git and modern software development workflows
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Curiosity, ownership mentality, and eagerness to learn new technologies

Nice to Have
  • Exposure to middleware or communication technologies such as ROS/ROS 2, DDS, shared memory IPC, or networking APIs
  • Familiarity with TCP/IP, sockets programming, or Linux system programming
  • Experience with CI/CD workflows and automated testing
  • Exposure to robotics, autonomous systems, or embedded software projects
  • Familiarity with build systems such as CMake or Bazel
  • Understanding of distributed systems concepts or real-time systems
  • Interest in automotive software, intelligent machines, or software-defined vehicles
  • Internship or academic experience involving systems programming or developer platforms

Why Apex.AI
  • Build foundational platform technology used in real-world autonomous and intelligent systems
  • Learn from highly experienced engineers working on technically challenging problems
  • Gain hands-on experience with middleware, runtime systems, and developer infrastructure
  • Engineering-driven culture with meaningful ownership, mentorship, and growth opportunities
  • Competitive compensation, benefits, and professional development opportunities
  • International team working at the forefront of mobility software innovation

About Apex.AI

Apex.AI is an international software company specializing in the development of safety-certified, developer-friendly, and scalable software for mobility systems, aiming to accelerate the transition to software-defined vehicles and mobility. Founded in 2017 by Jan Becker and Dejan Pangercic, the company is headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with additional offices in Munich, Stuttgart, Gothenburg, Tokyo, and Pangyo. To date, Apex.AI has raised over $75 million USD from world-class venture, financial and strategic investors including AGCO, Airbus Ventures, Canaan, Continental AG, Daimler Truck, HELLA Ventures, Jaguar Land Rover’s InMotion Ventures, LG Electronics, Lightspeed, Orillion, Toyota Ventures, Volvo Group Venture Capital and ZF.

The company’s flagship product, Apex.OS, consists of two core components: Apex.Grace and Apex.Ida.

  • Apex.Grace is an application runtime framework in the form of a software development kit (SDK). It provides a robust framework for developing real-time, reliable, and safe applications. Core APIs are based on ROS 2 APIs with numerous extensions enabling real-time execution, reliable performance, deployment into large fleets, system state management, safety, security, and much more. It is safety-certified to ISO 26262 ASIL D.
  • Apex.Ida is a communication middleware delivering optimal high-performance data transport across use cases. These use cases range from fully autonomous vehicles with dozens of high-resolution cameras to small signals with ultra-high frequencies in safety-critical domains. Its core is based on a shared memory data transport with connectors into DDS, SOME/IP, MQTT, CAN, and many more protocols, all abstracted into a single application-facing API.

Additionally, Apex.AI offers:

  • Apex.Alan provides customers with a highly optimized and efficient software integration, development environment, build, test, and delivery process.
  • Apex.OS for V&V enables record and playback of very large and diverse data streams, both time- and data-deterministically, which is crucial for replay, analysis, and performance evaluation of complex autonomous systems.

Apex.AI’s software solutions are utilized across a diverse range of industries, including automotive, agriculture, medical, and defense sectors. The products enable developers to efficiently create and deploy safe, reliable, and high-performance applications, thereby accelerating the adoption of software-defined mobility systems. Through its innovative software solutions and strategic partnerships, Apex.AI is at the forefront of transforming the mobility industry, facilitating the development of next-generation vehicles and systems.

  • Deploy, integrate, and support Apex.AI software in customer environments

  • Partner with internal engineering teams to improve product capabilities, usability, and performance
  • Contribute features, fixes, and enhancements directly to Apex.OS
  • Deliver technical presentations, workshops, and customer training sessions
  • Help accelerate customer adoption and success across automotive and intelligent machine platforms

    • What You Bring
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related technical field
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience in modern C++
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills across complex software systems
  • Experience developing software for embedded or distributed systems
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to work directly with customers and cross-functional teams
  • Experience using modern development workflows and tools such as Git, GitLab, CI/CD pipelines, and issue tracking systems
  • Self-driven and comfortable operating independently in dynamic technical environments

    • Nice To Have
  • Experience in automotive, robotics, aerospace, industrial automation, or other safety-critical domains
  • Familiarity with operating systems, networking, and communication protocols (UDP, multicast, TCP/IP, DDS, ROS/ROS 2)
  • Understanding of real-time systems and automotive software architectures such as AUTOSAR
  • Experience in technical consulting, field engineering, developer support, or professional services
  • Customer enablement or technical training experience
  • Familiarity with build systems such as Bazel or CMake
  • Experience working with Linux-based development environments

    • Apex.AI is an international software company specializing in the development of safety-certified, developer-friendly, and scalable software for mobility systems, aiming to accelerate the transition to software-defined vehicles and mobility. Founded in 2017 by Jan Becker and Dejan Pangercic, the company is headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with additional offices in Munich, Stuttgart, Gothenburg, Tokyo, and Pangyo. To date, Apex.AI has raised over $75 million USD from world-class venture, financial and strategic investors including AGCO, Airbus Ventures, Canaan, Continental AG, Daimler Truck, HELLA Ventures, Jaguar Land Rover’s InMotion Ventures, LG Electronics, Lightspeed, Orillion, Toyota Ventures, Volvo Group Venture Capital and ZF.

    The company’s flagship product, Apex.OS, consists of two core components: Apex.Grace and Apex.Ida.

    • Apex.Grace is an application runtime framework in the form of a software development kit (SDK). It provides a robust framework for developing real-time, reliable, and safe applications. Core APIs are based on ROS 2 APIs with numerous extensions enabling real-time execution, reliable performance, deployment into large fleets, system state management, safety, security, and much more. It is safety-certified to ISO 26262 ASIL D.
    • Apex.Ida is a communication middleware delivering optimal high-performance data transport across use cases. These use cases range from fully autonomous vehicles with dozens of high-resolution cameras to small signals with ultra-high frequencies in safety-critical domains. Its core is based on a shared memory data transport with connectors into DDS, SOME/IP, MQTT, CAN, and many more protocols, all abstracted into a single application-facing API.

    Additionally, Apex.AI offers:

    • Apex.Alan provides customers with a highly optimized and efficient software integration, development environment, build, test, and delivery process.
    • Apex.OS for V&V enables record and playback of very large and diverse data streams, both time- and data-deterministically, which is crucial for replay, analysis, and performance evaluation of complex autonomous systems.

    Apex.AI’s software solutions are utilized across a diverse range of industries, including automotive, agriculture, medical, and defense sectors. The products enable developers to efficiently create and deploy safe, reliable, and high-performance applications, thereby accelerating the adoption of software-defined mobility systems. Through its innovative software solutions and strategic partnerships, Apex.AI is at the forefront of transforming the mobility industry, facilitating the development of next-generation vehicles and systems.

Deine Mission

syte benutzt komplexe Algorithmen, die auf Basis von 3D-Punktwolken und 3D-Modellen Gebäudemetriken ausrechnen. Typische Beispiele für relevante Metriken sind Geschossfläche, Anzahl Geschosse, Volumen und Gebäudehöhen. Um schnelle Entwicklungszyklen zu gewährleisten, und Änderungen an den Algorithmen auf Knopfdruck quantitativ und automatisiert bewerten zu können, ist syte auf hochwertige QA-Daten angewiesen. Um diesen Datensatz systematisch auszubauen und zu härten und damit die Grundlage, auf der unsere Algorithmen gemessen werden, zu entwickeln, suchen wir dich als Werkstudent Data QA & Algorithm Benchmarking (m/w/d) zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt in Münster. 

Deine Aufgaben

  • Ground Truth Audit: Du evaluierst die Korrektheit bestehender Testdaten und ermittelst hierfür neue Metriken, die wir zur Evaluation unserer Algorithmen verwenden können.
  • Edge Cases jagen: Du ermittelst neue Testdaten für schwierige Gebäude (z.B. komplexe Dachformen, Bäume über den Dächern) und integrierst diese in den Gesamtdatensatz.
  • Data Sourcing: Du ermittelst potenzielle Quellen für neue Testdatensätze und integrierst diese möglichst automatisiert.
  • Benchmarking & Insights: Du führst unsere Benchmarking-Pipelines aus, um sowohl die Algorithmen als auch die Qualität der Daten quantitativ zu bewerten. Die Ergebnisse dieser Analysen visualisierst und kommunizierst du verständlich, sodass sich daraus Handlungsempfehlungen ableiten.
  • Pipeline Engineering: Du implementierst und testest Verbesserungen in den Benchmarking-Pipelines und den Parametern der Algorithmen.


Dein Profil

  • Dein Studium: Du studierst in einem höheren Bachelorsemester oder ersten Mastersemester (Geo-/Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder hast einen Schwerpunkt in Data Science/Statistik. Du hast auch einen gültigen Immatrikulationsnachweis. 
  • Analytische Fähigkeiten: Du arbeitest dich gerne tief in Daten ein und begeisterst dich für die statistische Analyse der Daten.
  • Neugierde für die komplexe Daten: Dir gefällt die Arbeit an und das Nachvollziehen von komplexeren Algorithmen in einer anspruchsvollen Domäne.
  • Teamfähigkeit: Du arbeitest mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch und kannst dich gut im Team koordinieren.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (mind. C1) und fließend Englisch (mind. B2).
  • Pluspunkt: Du hast Vorerfahrungen in den Bereichen Architektur oder PropTech und erste Programmiererfahrungen mit Python.


Dein Einstiegstermin und Einsatzort

  • Einstiegstermin: zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt
  • Einsatzort: Münster (ca. 1 Tag pro Woche im Office)
  • Anstellungsart: Werkstudium (12-20 Std./Woche, Zeiten flexibel)


Deine Benefits

  • Dein attraktives Gehalt: Wir sorgen dafür, dass jeder Aspekt deiner Reise bei syte motivierend ist. Wir kennen deinen Wert!

  • Deine Hardware: Unser syte-Team ist mit modernster Hard- und Software ausgestattet.

  • Dein Team: Einmal im Quartal trifft sich das gesamte Team für zwei Tage zum Arbeiten und um gemeinsam Erfolge zu feiern.

data.description:
Über uns

Wie bleibt ein RAG-System präzise, wenn aus tausend Dokumenten hunderttausend werden? Wie orchestriert man mehrere Modellanbieter sauber hinter einer Oberfläche? Während anderswo noch Prototypen gezeigt werden, arbeiten unsere Kunden längst damit - mit ihren Daten, ihren Regeln, gehostet in Deutschland. Als Senior Engineer verantwortest du Kernfunktionen und Architektur unserer Plattform, vom Retrieval bis ins Frontend - und du entwickelst sie so, wie wir arbeiten: AI-gestützt, mit Coding-Agents als Teil des Werkzeugkastens und mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum für deine Ideen. Du suchst eine Rolle, in der technische Tiefe und Produktverantwortung zusammenkommen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen!


Das gibt es zu tun

  • Architektur & Umsetzung Du entwirfst und skalierst verteilte Systeme und Microservices - immer mit Blick auf Wartbarkeit, Stabilität und die Frage, was in zwei Jahren noch trägt. 
  • KI-Features bauen, die im Alltag halten Du entwickelst die Kernfunktionen unserer Plattform - von RAG-basierten Wissensdatenbanken über KI-Apps für einzelne Fachbereiche bis zu Voice-, Übersetzungs- und Analytics-Funktionen. 
  • Full-Stack liefern Du entwickelst performante APIs, modellierst Daten und Datenbanken und setzt moderne Oberflächen im Frontend um - vom Retrieval bis zur Benutzeroberfläche.
  • Daten, Sicherheit & Mandantenfähigkeit Du modellierst Daten für Multi-Tenancy und rollenbasierte Berechtigungen - so, dass niemand über die KI Zugriff auf etwas bekommt, das er nicht sehen darf. Verschlüsselung, Datenminimierung und Auditierbarkeit denkst du von Anfang an mit. 
  • Betrieb & Observability mitdenken Du sorgst dafür, dass Qualität, Kosten und Verhalten der KI-Features im Betrieb sichtbar bleiben - mit Evaluations, Monitoring und klaren Guardrails, damit die Plattform auch bei wachsender Nutzung stabil und effizient läuft.
  • Komplexität beherrschen Du entwickelst bestehende Systeme weiter, schaffst klare Strukturen und reduzierst technische Schulden dort, wo sie langfristig teuer werden und lässt sie stehen, wo sie es nicht sind. 
  • AI-gestützt entwickeln – und den Standard dafür setzen Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit Coding-Assistenten und Agenten, holst mehr aus ihnen heraus als Autocomplete und weißt genau, wo ihre Grenzen liegen. Neue Tools und Workflows testest du früh, bewertest sie ehrlich und etablierst im Team, wie wir sie sinnvoll einsetzen.
  • Team & Produkt weiterbringen Du arbeitest eng mit Product Owner, UX und unseren Consultants zusammen, übersetzt echte Kunden-Use-Cases in Technik, machst technische Entscheidungen transparent und bringst unsere Junior Developer durch Code Reviews und Mentoring fachlich weiter. 


Das bringst Du mit

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung komplexer Softwaresysteme, idealerweise im KI- bzw. SaaS/Cloud-Umfeld
  • Sehr gute TypeScript-Kenntnisse, Erfahrung mit Node.js und idealerweise Frameworks wie NestJS 
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Softwarearchitektur für verteilte Systeme - Microservices, API-Design, Skalierung 
  • Erfahrung im Frontend, z. B. mit Vue.js, sowie ein gutes Verständnis für Full-Stack-Zusammenhänge 
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Datenbanken (z. B. PostgreSQL), Datenmodellierung und Performance-Optimierung 
  • Erfahrung mit Cloud-Plattformen (z. B. AWS), Docker und dem Betrieb von SaaS-Anwendungen 
  • AI-gestütztes Entwickeln ist für dich Alltag: Du arbeitest routiniert mit Coding-Assistenten und -Agenten (z. B. Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot), kennst ihre Grenzen und prüfst generierten Code kritisch, statt ihm zu vertrauen 
  • Du bist nah am Puls der Entwicklung: Du probierst neue Tools, Modelle und Workflows aktiv aus und bringst die guten ins Team - Erfahrung mit agentischen Setups (z. B. Coding-Agents in der Cloud, MCP-Integrationen, automatisierte Reviews) ist ein starkes Plus 
  • Tieferes Verständnis moderner AI-/LLM-Konzepte wie RAG, Function Calling, Embeddings oder Agenten
  • Clean Code, Testing und Code Reviews sind für dich selbstverständlich und du bringst Junior Developers durch Reviews und Mentoring gern fachlich weiter 
  • Du triffst technische Entscheidungen und kannst sie nachvollziehbar vertreten - auf Deutsch und auf Englisch 
  • Erfahrung mit DSGVO, ISO 27001 oder dem EU AI Act sind ein Plus 

Was uns wichtig ist 
Frameworks kann man lernen. Was uns viel wichtiger ist: Verantwortung übernehmen, das Produkt mitdenken, Anforderungen konstruktiv hinterfragen und technische Entscheidungen treffen, die man auch in zwei Jahren noch begründen kann - pragmatisch abgewogen zwischen Perfektion und Geschwindigkeit. Konkret heißt das: Du entwirfst morgens die Architektur für ein neues Feature, reviewst mittags Pull Requests, entwickelst nachmittags selbst und bringst dabei unser Team fachlich weiter. Wer lieber Tickets abarbeitet und auf Anforderungen wartet, wird bei uns nicht glücklich.


Das bekommst Du

  • Start & Welcoming so wie du es verdienst! Ein strukturiertes Onboarding mit echten Ansprechpersonen - damit du vom ersten Tag an durchstartest.
  • Remote Work Homeoffice innerhalb von Deutschland oder Arbeiten in unserem modernen Büro in Offenburg? Arbeite so, wie es für dich am besten passt.
  • AI-first arbeiten, statt darüber zu reden Lizenzen für Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot & Co. stellen wir. Neue Tools und Modelle darfst du ausprobieren, statt sie zu beantragen – und deine Erkenntnisse verändern, wie das ganze Team arbeitet. 
  • Kurze Wege, keine Entscheidungsgremien Architekturentscheidungen trifft das Team, das sie später auch betreibt. Deine Ideen landen im Produkt, nicht in einem Backlog-Archiv. 
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit 20 % Arbeitgeberzuschuss - deutlich über dem gesetzlichen Standard.
  • Du entscheidest ob Hansefit-Mitgliedschaft oder 50 € monatlich per Spendit Card - dein Benefit, deine Wahl.

  • Jobticket oder JobRad - wir machen deinen Weg ins Office einfacher und grüner.
  • Feiern gehört dazu - Quarterly Allhands Events, Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier oder einfach so - wir wissen, wie man Korken knallen lässt.
  • Ein Team, das wirklich zählt. Flache Hierarchien, schnelle Entscheidungen und ein offenes Ohr auch für das, was dich persönlich bewegt.


Das sind WIR

Transformation ist für uns kein Trend, sondern unser Auftrag: Seit 1995 begleitet die avenit Group Unternehmen dabei, sich für die digitale Zukunft neu aufzustellen - ganzheitlich, strategisch und mit klarem Blick für nachhaltige Erfolge. Wir glauben daran, dass nachhaltiger Erfolg auf Augenhöhe entsteht; im echten Dialog mit unseren Kunden. Unsere 60 Kolleg:innen lassen diese Vision jeden Tag zur Realität werden. Unser innovatives KI-Team in der Vusyon GmbH sucht Verstärkung, um unsere KI-Plattform für den Mittelstand weiter zu entwickeln. Neugierig, was uns dort besonders macht? Mehr erfährst du hier: https://vusyon.ai/

As (Senior) Software Engineer - Healthcare Applications at Snke you will shape how clinicians interact with patient data every day. You will build and maintain healthcare web applications end to end, with modular and reusable frontend widgets and backend microservices that connect to hospital systems via FHIR, DICOM and HL7. You'll also develop shared libraries that enable other teams to do the same, from ready-to-use clients for healthcare standards to authentication and authorization flows. By collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, you will drive innovation creating scalable, next-generation applications using modern technologies and agile development practices.

  • Design and develop modern healthcare applications and services using TypeScript and React, focusing on clinical workflows and user-facing application features
  • Build reusable, independently deployable frontend widgets based on a microfrontend architecture, enabling teams to compose applications from shared building blocks
  • Develop and maintain backend services following a a microservice-based architecture, and integrate them with existing services using FHIR, DICOM and HL7 standards

As an Infrastructure Engineer, you will be responsible for the reliable delivery and deployment of our software systems to customer environments. You will ensure that deployments are automated, resilient, and adaptable to diverse on-premise and hybrid infrastructures.
Operating at the intersection of infrastructure, software, and customer environments, you will play a key role in enabling smooth commissioning, stable operations, and continuous improvement of our deployment processes.

Your Tasks & Responsibilities

  • Own and execute end-to-end deployments across on-premise and hybrid environments, including software rollout, commissioning, and go-live support
  • Configure and validate infrastructure (compute, storage, clusters, networking, mTLS) to ensure production readiness
  • Troubleshoot and resolve deployment and infrastructure issues; support Customer Success team during escalations
  • Develop and maintain deployment automation, runbooks, and standardized procedures
  • Implement automated rollback, recovery workflows, and improve CI/CD-driven deployment processes
  • Monitor system health and capacity; manage lifecycle activities such as patching, upgrades, and maintenance
  • Implement and test backup and recovery strategies, ensuring compliance with recovery objectives
  • Coordinate with customer IT and internal teams on network, security, and hardware integration requirements
  • Document site-specific configurations and feed insights back to improve architecture, tooling, and deployment processes
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by optimizing workflows and supporting internal test environments


Qualifications

  • Strong experience with Linux systems administration and container runtimes (Docker, Docker Compose)
  • Hands-on experience deploying and operating Kubernetes-based systems in production
  • Solid knowledge of networking (VLANs, firewalls, VPNs, DNS, OT/IT environments)
  • Experience with infrastructure as code and automation tools (Ansible, Terraform)
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab) and version control (Git)
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki)
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills in complex environments
  • Experience with certificate management (PKI)


Nice to haves

  • Experience with air-gapped or restricted-network deployments
  • Familiarity with Helm and GitOps tools (e.g., ArgoCD, FluxCD)
  • Knowledge of industrial networks and OT/IT convergence
  • Experience with Debian/Linux packaging
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., RHCE, LPIC, CKA)


We offer

  • We are a diverse, global team of 100+ creative thinkers, algorithmic brains, makers, movers, and shakers.
  • Our approach comes from a continuous cycle: assemble, weld, code, test, deploy or delete, and repeat. That is how we deliver innovative solutions to tackle the biggest intralogistics challenges.
  • You will find our tech space nestled within the eastern region of Munich. It serves as a hub for our team's creativity and collaboration, featuring state-of-the-art meeting rooms, a fully-equipped electronics lab, and a spacious robotics testing area. Our team also enjoys a variety of social spaces, all within the modern infrastructure of the renowned Neue Balan campus.
  • We are more than just a workplace: we are a community. We encourage connection and affiliation through a range of activities: hiking trips, running events, ping pong tournaments, and quiz nights — there is something for everyone.
  • We also believe that work should be rewarding in more ways than just one. That is why we offer competitive salaries and benefits like EGYM Wellpass, language courses, Jobrad, and flexible working hours.
  • If you are moving to join our team, we provide relocation and visa support to help make the transition as smooth as possible.


Diversity and Inclusion

We are an equal opportunity employer and highly value diversity and inclusivity, which we see as strengths. While we are making progress, we are not yet where we want to be. Still, we believe in the power of a diverse workforce and welcome applicants of all genders, ethnicities, ages, national origins, sexual orientations, cultures, and educational backgrounds. Our goal is to create a work culture where everyone feels equally heard and included.

Deine Aufgaben

Willkommen bei SIMCON – einem führenden High-Tech-Softwareunternehmen im Bereich Computer-Aided Engineering (CAE). Mit mehr als 30 Jahren Erfahrung entwickeln wir innovative Simulationslösungen für die Kunststoffindustrie und unterstützen Unternehmen weltweit bei der effizienten Entwicklung und Optimierung von Kunststoffbauteilen. 
 
Zur Unterstützung unseres Application Engineering Teams suchen wir eine engagierte Werkstudentin bzw. einen engagierten Werkstudenten im Bereich Simulation & Application Engineering. In dieser Rolle arbeitest Du aktiv an realen Simulations- und Kundenprojekten mit und erhältst tiefe Einblicke in moderne CAE- und Spritzgießprozesse. 

Mitarbeit an Simulationsprojekten: 
Du unterstützt unser Team bei der Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Auswertung von Simulationsprojekten im Bereich Kunststoffspritzguss, unter anderem durch: 

  • Durchführung interner Simulationsprojekte
  • Mitarbeit an Kundenprojekten und technischen Dienstleistungen
  • Erstellung und Durchführung von Benchmark-Simulationen
  • Analyse, Interpretation und Dokumentation von Simulationsergebnissen
 
Unterstützung bei Lern- und Schulungsinhalten: 
Du wirkst bei der Erstellung und Aufbereitung technischer Inhalte für unterschiedliche Lernformate mit, z. B.: 
  • Online Academy Inhalte
  • Schulungsunterlagen
  • Tutorials und Selbstlernmaterialien
  • Präsentationen und technische Dokumentationen
 
Unterstützung im technischen Kundensupport: 
Du unterstützt unser Team bei der Bearbeitung technischer Kundenanfragen, beispielsweise durch: 
  • Mitarbeit bei Supportfällen
  • Nachverfolgung von Kundenanfragen
  • Vorbereitung technischer Informationen und Lösungsansätze


Dein Profil

  • Eingeschriebene:r Student:in im Bereich Maschinenbau, Kunststofftechnik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder in einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.
  • Technisches Verständnis und Interesse an Simulation und Spritzgießtechnik.
  • Strukturierte, selbstständige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise.
  • Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office.
Wünschenswert: 
  • Erste Erfahrungen mit CAD- oder Simulationssoftware.
  • Erste Erfahrungen im Umgang mit KI-Tools oder Coding Agents (z. B. ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot).
Wichtig: Du musst nicht alles mitbringen – entscheidend sind deine Lernbereitschaft, Neugier und Begeisterung für technische Themen.


Warum wir?

Arbeitsweise & Kultur 

  • Praxisnah: Wir messen unsere Simulationen daran, wie gut sie reale Probleme lösen.
  • Pragmatic Engineering: Wir entwickeln Lösungen, die echten Mehrwert schaffen – klar, effizient und ohne unnötige Komplexität.
  • Iterativ: Wir testen früh, lernen schnell und verbessern kontinuierlich.
  • Eigenverantwortlich: Du übernimmst eigene Themen und gestaltest aktiv mit.
  • Hands-on Mindset: Wir probieren Dinge aus, übernehmen Verantwortung und entwickeln pragmatische Lösungen gemeinsam weiter.
Arbeitsumfeld & Benefits 
  • Fully Remote Arbeit in Deutschland falls gewünscht.
  • Einblicke in moderne Simulations- und Engineering-Prozesse.
  • Echte Verantwortung: Du arbeitest an realen Kundenprojekten mit direktem Impact.
  • Modernes Umfeld: Einsatz von AI, Automatisierung und datengetriebenen Methoden.
  • Steile Lernkurve: Du arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Simulationsexpert:innen zusammen und entwickelst dich fachlich schnell weiter.
  • Teamkultur: Offene Kommunikation, kurze Entscheidungswege und ein motiviertes Team mit viel technischem Know-how.

data.description:
Job description

We are building modern, customer-facing software for the temp-staffing industry, integrating capabilities from multiple ERP systems and countries into reliable applications, workflows, services, and reusable platform components.

We are looking for a product-minded senior fullstack engineer who can turn ambiguous business requirements and complex existing systems into production-grade backend services, APIs, integrations, internal tools, and intuitive user interfaces.

TypeScript is central to our technology landscape. Experience with .NET and C# is strongly valued, while engineers with a background in strongly typed languages such as Java are also welcome. Comfort working across different stacks and languages is essential.

AI and LLM tooling are central to how we work. You should use AI-native workflows to explore faster, build in parallel, validate assumptions, and ship high-quality production solutions. You should care about correctness and maintainability, understand integration and business edge cases, choose simple and robust solutions, and own outcomes from exploration to production.


Your tasks

  • Fullstack Product Engineering: Build customer-facing applications, backend services, APIs, internal tools, admin interfaces, automation, job runners, and configurable workflows
  • Backend & Domain Logic: Design maintainable services, APIs, business logic, asynchronous processes, validation rules, and reusable components
  • Frontend Engineering: Build intuitive and maintainable user interfaces using TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks
  • Integrations: Connect applications with ERP systems, internal platforms, external APIs, databases, queues, files, and third-party services
  • Cloud & Production Ownership: Deploy and operate reliable cloud solutions, preferably AWS, owning monitoring, alerts, failure handling, security, performance, cost, and operational reliability


Your profile

  • Hands-on with Claude Code, Codex, and agent-based workflows; GitHub Copilot-style autocomplete alone is not enough
  • Familiar with worktrees, subagents, MCP, structured prompts, harness engineering, parallelization, and validating AI-generated code and analysis to production quality
  • Strong fullstack/backend experience, ideally with .NET and TypeScript
  • Able to build production-grade services, APIs, scripts, tools, automation, and clean interfaces; comfortable with version control, review, debugging, testing, and existing systems
  • Strong understanding of application architecture, API design, domain modeling, integration patterns, asynchronous processing, and maintainable software boundaries
  • Comfortable with SQL, relational databases, schema design, transactions, migrations, indexing, and application-level data access
  • Hands-on with AWS or similar cloud environments, including storage, databases, queues, containers, serverless/scheduled processing, SDKs, and APIs
  • Understands deployment, secrets, networking, permissions, runtime configuration, scalability, performance, cost, and operational trade-offs
You may be a good fit if you are driven to improve how software is built, use AI and agent-based workflows to move faster, experiment with better approaches, and turn ambiguous problems into reliable production solutions. You should enjoy working across the stack, taking ownership beyond predefined tickets, improving existing systems, and rigorously validating AI-generated output rather than accepting it at face value. This role is less suitable for someone who prefers narrow responsibilities, fixed processes, or working within a single technical area without contributing to broader product and engineering outcomes.


Your benefits

  • Work across AI-powered SaaS and cloud-native products, use modern AI tooling daily, and shape pragmatic infrastructure that helps teams ship faster and more safely
  • Collaboration in an empathetic, appreciative team with room to contribute ideas and take ownership
  • Individual development opportunities, structured onboarding, and interdisciplinary collaboration
  • Flexible working models including hybrid work, home office, and mobile working
  • A modern tech environment and agile ways of working
  • Additional benefits such as pension plans, health offers, and employee discounts


I look forward to receiving your application

Why we are looking for support

We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer to join our team in Germany. 

You’ll be part of a delivery team working across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, B2B Commerce, and Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud. While you don’t need prior experience with Consumer Goods Cloud, you’ll be expected to learn and work with it as part of our core solution landscape.

This is a German-speaking position. Professional fluency in German and English is required, as you will work directly with German-speaking clients and international project teams.

To give you more insights of your working environment, on the organization level you will work on a regular basis in a team of 5-10 developers to gather ideas & improve already existing processes. On a project level you will work in an agile project team of 4-7 people, depending on the project size, to deliver projects to our clients.
What you will find with us: 

  • Real-world Salesforce projects that go beyond textbook use cases
  • A team that values thoughtful engineering, scalable delivery, and ownership
  • Opportunities to learn Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud in live client environments
  • Clear growth paths toward technical lead, solution architect, or industry specialist roles


Your tasks

  • Lead the development, and deployment of Salesforce solutions using different Cloud solutions.
  • Develop end-to-end Salesforce solutions using both configuration and customization
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze business processes, and deliver scalable solutions
  • Develop Salesforce components using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Flows
  • Work closely with solution architects and functional consultants to build scalable solutions across Sales, Service, Commerce, and Consumer Goods Cloud
  • Integrate Salesforce with external systems using APIs and middleware tools (e.g. MuleSoft, SAP CPI)
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, and quality assurance
  • Contribute to DevOps automation using Git, Gearset, or DevOps Center
  • Suggest improvements to performance, reusability, or developer experience
  • Support defect resolution, enhancements, and roll-out activities
  • Stay up-to-date on the latest Salesforce innovations and contribute to internal initiatives and team growth.


Requirements

  • 3–7+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience
  • Strong skills in Apex, LWC, SOQL/SOSL, and Flow
  • Experience working across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or Commerce implementations
  • Understanding of integration design, platform limits, and test automation
  • Familiarity with Git-based version control and CI/CD tooling
  • Experience working in structured project teams or consulting environments
  • Interest in learning Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud and applying it in real-world programs
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to debug complex technical issues.
  • Fluent in English and German - other languages are a plus.
  • Demonstrated drive to improve how things are done—whether in performance, automation, or usability
  • The ability to collaborate across technical and functional teams
  • A mindset geared toward learning and adapting in enterprise-scale environments


Nice to Have

  • Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II, JavaScript Developer I, Integration Architecture Designer)
  • Experience with Experience Cloud, CPQ, or Consumer Goods Cloud
  • Background working with or delivering for consumer goods or retail clients
  • Familiarity with agile delivery tools like JIRA, Confluence, and TestRail
  • Experience working with XML based design contracts and Cordova mobile framework

data.title: Working Student Marketing (B2B SaaS Startup)

data.description:
Our Mission

Join us in reshaping global trade in a fast-growing startup!
We are traide AI – a VC-backed, B2B deep tech startup based in Berlin, using AI to solve one of the most overlooked yet critical challenges in international trade: compliance. Our software automates product classification, reduces regulatory errors, and helps customers save up to 83% of their time on a process that is critical to get right. 
Trusted by leading brands like BMW, RIMOWA, OBI, Edeka, we've achieved 3x growth over the past 12 months – and we're just getting started.


Your tasks

  • Own the full loop. Take a user problem from rough idea to shipped interface: partner or write the brief, design the flow, prototype it, partner with engineering, ship it with as few handoffs as possible.
  • Use AI as a force multiplier. Explore and prototype with AI tools, Figma, or code, whatever gets there fastest. Your taste is the editorial layer: you know when AI-generated UI is wrong even when it looks right, and you fix it.
  • Solve from first principles. Reason about the right interaction for the user problem instead of reaching for a component library.
  • Sweat the final 10%. Craft the details others miss, the ones that make a compliance product feel trustworthy.
  • Work in small, focused pods. No layers, no waiting. You'll work closely with two or three others who share the same model.
  • Be accountable to outcomes. Know the metric your team is moving. Measure your week by what changed for users, not by screens delivered.
  • Stretch beyond design. Read the API spec, engage users directly, build in code when it's faster than Figma.


Who we’re looking for

Craft is the baseline here, not a nice-to-have. What sets you apart is range and judgment: you know what good looks like, you know when something looks right but feels wrong, and you can get a team there with you.

  • Fluency in English (C1+) is required. German (C1) is a plus, but not a must-have.
  • Genuine design craft with a track record: you've shipped interfaces real users navigated without explanation, and you can point to the metric that moved.
  • Strong visual sensibility, high standards, and an eye for detail.
  • Range across Design, Product, and Engineering: you've gone from user problem to testable prototype without waiting for a brief, and used AI coding tools to build something real. You're not dependent on an engineer to realize your vision.
  • You've built personal AI workflows that make you meaningfully faster, and you know when to trust, edit, or reject AI output.
  • Comfortable in ambiguity: you ship, collect signal, and iterate rather than waiting for full clarity.
  • You are excited to show your work (portfolio or examples).
  • Ideally you've worked on products where getting it wrong has real consequences (fintech, healthtech, logistics, compliance), but that's not a must-have.
  • Berlin-based or willing to relocate.
This role is not for you if…
  • You want a PM to define the problem and an engineer to implement the solution.
  • You resist working in code or with AI.
  • You hand off polished Figma files and believe your job is done.
  • You judge yourself on taste alone, not outcomes.

Interview process:

  1. First Call — Intro on what we do with Max (Hiring manager) 
  2. Second Call — Portfolio walkthrough with Sebastian (Designer) 
  3. Third Call — Get to know our product and culture with our Product team (group call)
  4. On-site Day — Meet our team in our Berlin office and work on a real problem together with us.
  5. (Potentially) quick ,,vibe check'' call- with founder (Leonie or Hendrik)


Why us?

What you can expect

  • Enjoy benefits like an Urban Sports Club membership
  • Varied day-to-day → every problem comes with unique needs, so no two days are the same
  • Visible impact → you'll see the direct results of your work for both our customers and traide AI

Unsere Vision ist eine Welt, in der kein Tier mehr für die Herstellung von Lebensmitteln leidet. Unsere Mission lautet: Gemeinsam Tierschutzstandards erhöhen und den Verbrauch von Tierprodukten senken. Mit unserer Arbeit wirken wir in den Bereichen Wirtschaft, Recht und Politik. Auf allen Ebenen gehen wir mit den jeweiligen Akteur:innen praktikable Schritte in Richtung eines respektvollen Umgangs mit den Tieren und erleichtern auch vermeintlichen Gegner:innen den Ausstieg aus bisherigen Handlungsmustern.


Als Data Analyst:in Fundraising bist du Teil unseres sechsköpfigen Fundraising & Engagement-Teams. Der Bereich Fundraising & Engagement verbindet engagierte Menschen mit unserer Mission - als Spender:innen oder Freiwillige. Mit kreativen Aktionen sichert er die Finanzierung unserer Arbeit.


Das bewirkst du bei uns

Du entwickelst und pflegst ein skalierbares Performance-Monitoring für den Bereich Fundraising und Engagement. Darüber hinaus optimierst du Fundraising- und Mobilisierungsmaßnahmen und stellst Datenqualität und Datenintegrität sicher.

Damit sorgst du dafür, dass Fundraising- und Engagement-Maßnahmen datenbasiert geplant, segmentiert, ausgewertet und optimiert werden können. Mit KPI-Reportings, Tests und Analysen lieferst du belastbare Entscheidungsgrundlagen für die Weiterentwicklung von Fundraising, Mobilisierung und Unterstützer:innen-Journeys.


Im Einzelnen bedeutet das

  • Du segmentierst und bereitest Daten für Fundraising- und Engagement-Maßnahmen vor

  • Du entwickelst, pflegst und dokumentierst SQL-Abfragen und wiederkehrende Auswertungslogiken

  • Du wertest Fundraising-, Engagement- und Mobilisierungsmaßnahmen entlang vereinbarter KPIs aus

  • Du erstellst Monatsreportings und Dashboards mit den wichtigsten Steuerungskennzahlen

  • Du bereitest A/B- und multivariate Tests vor, wertest sie aus und leitest Learnings ab

  • Du analysierst Unterstützer:innen-Journeys, Zielgruppen und Segmente als Grundlage für Optimierung

  • Du erstellst ad-hoc-Auswertungen und Handlungsempfehlungen für strategische Entscheidungen


Dein Profil


  • Idealerweise hast du einen Studienabschluss oder eine Ausbildung im Bereich Fundraising, BWL, Controlling, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Statistik oder Data Science. Wir sind aber auch offen für Quereinsteiger:innen mit entsprechenden nachgewiesenen Qualifikationen und Referenzen.

  • Du hast mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im Digital Fundraising einer Non-Profit-Organisation.

  • Du pflegst einen sicheren Umgang mit Instrumenten der qualitativen und quantitativen Datenanalyse inkl. Tracking- und Analyse Tools.

  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit SQL-Datenbanken und CRM Systemen.

  • Du hast Erfahrung mit A/B- und multivariatem Testing.

  • Du hast bereits erste Erfahrung mit Projektmanagement-Tools wie Asana, monday.com, Jira oder vergleichbaren Anwendungen und nutzt sie, um Aufgaben, Abstimmungen und Projektfortschritte übersichtlich zu organisieren. (wir arbeiten mit Asana)

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und eigenständig mit einer hohen Problemlösungskompetenz.

  • Auch wenn es mal stressig wird, weil z. B. eine Deadline näher rückt, bleibst du entspannt.

  • Auf Unvorhergesehenes reagierst du flexibel und suchst passende Alternativen.

  • Du arbeitest gerne mit anderen zusammen - auch wenn nicht alle an einem Ort sind.

  • Du hast bereits erste Erfahrung damit, KI-Tools reflektiert im Arbeitsalltag einzusetzen und weißt, dass gute Ergebnisse klare Aufgabenstellungen, ausreichend Kontext und eine sorgfältige Prüfung brauchen.

  • Du identifizierst dich mit unserer Vision, Mission und Kultur.


Was wir dir bieten

  • Eine unbefristete Vollzeit-Stelle auf 35-Basis: Als Teil des F&E-Teams bewirkst du direkt gesellschaftliche Veränderungen und verbesserst den Tierschutz.

  • Home-Office-Möglichkeiten: Du wohnst in Berlin oder Umgebung und arbeitest mit flexiblen, familienfreundlichen Arbeitszeiten im hybriden Modell (Homeoffice & Büro).

  • Professionelles Team: Kollegialer, offener Austausch in einem motivierten Team

  • Weiterbildung: Aktive Förderung von Fort- und Weiterbildungen


Haben wir dein Interesse geweckt?

Dann schick uns deine Bewerbung bis zum 04.09.2026 per Bewerbungsbutton. Wir möchten von dir erfahren, was dich motiviert, bei der Albert Schweitzer Stiftung zu arbeiten, weshalb du die beste Person für diese Rolle bist und wann du bei uns anfangen könntest. Our mission at Qwello is to revolutionize the charging industry, we are committed to turn the world from combustion to electric. We put the customer first. We know their needs and deliver results they love. We design, build and operate charging infrastructure for the public space. We excel in simplicity, user focus and engineering excellence. We value diversity of thought, background and approaches and foster a culture of belonging. We understand that the best products are built by excellent teams, not individual superstars.

Be part of shaping the E-mobility of the future!

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Embedded team - the team that designs, builds and ships Qwello's AC charging stations, from circuit board to firmware to the production line. This is not a pure software management role. Your team of 6-8 spans embedded software, electrical engineering and mechanical engineering, and your scope runs from the firmware release train for thousands of chargers in the field, through EMC labs and Eichrecht certification audits, to the contract manufacturer's factory floor.

Our firmware is built on embedded Linux (Yocto) and EVerest, the open source EV charging stack we actively contribute to upstream. We are working with Rust, Python, C & C++. You will not be the deepest specialist in any one of these - your tech leads are - but you must be technical enough to represent the team when they are not in the room, to challenge estimates, and to make trade-offs between firmware, hardware and regulatory constraints with confidence and competence.

If you have led embedded or hardware-adjacent teams, enjoy being the person to which a factory, a certification body and a firmware engineer all escalate in the same week, and who brings the self-organization to keep all of it moving without dropping balls, we would love to talk.

Please Note: Tell us about a physical product you helped ship - what your team built, what went wrong on the way to production, and what your part in fixing it was.


Your Responsibilities 🚀
  • Lead and grow a team of 6-8 engineers across embedded software, electrical and mechanical engineering: 1:1s, performance reviews, compensation input, hiring and, when needed, structured performance management
  • Own delivery: quarterly planning and OKRs with leadership, translating requests from our country organizations into scoped, estimated engineering work, and saying no with a rationale when needed
  • Own the firmware release train (dev, canary, production) for the charger fleet and be answerable for fleet-impacting incidents alongside our operations teams
  • Drive certification and compliance as a permanent workstream: Eichrecht (Modul B and Modul D), CE and EMC campaigns, VDE and TÜV interactions, DSO assessments and upcoming regulation and technologies like vehicle-to-grid (V2G), changes to the AFIR and such
  • Manage key vendors and partners across the full bill of materials: our EVCC board supplier, meter vendors, payment terminal providers, the contract manufacturer running our production line, and our open source partners upstream
  • Keep production shippable: end-of-line testing, BOM changes and cost analysis, supply chain risk, and same-day escalation support when the factory line stops
  • Build a resilient team structure: develop tech leads, keep yourself off the critical path of IC work, and reduce bus factor on certification and hardware knowledge

    • Your Profile ✨
  • Several years of experience managing embedded, firmware or hardware-adjacent engineering teams, including hiring, performance reviews and difficult personnel conversations
  • A solid engineering background in embedded systems: you have shipped firmware or devices to production and can hold a technical argument with strong, opinionated senior engineers
  • Comfort with the physical side of the product: electronics, EMC, test labs, manufacturing. You do not need to design circuits, but this world must not be foreign to you
  • Demonstrated experience working with certification bodies, notified bodies or regulated products - or the appetite and rigor to own this quickly
  • Outstanding self-organization: this role has many parallel threads (people, releases, audits, vendors, factory), and following through reliably is the single most important skill
  • A track record of building self-managing teams: delegating, developing tech leads and staying off the critical path rather than being the hero
  • Excellent communication skills in English, from firmware engineers to executives to external auditors

    • Nice to have
  • German language skills - a significant part of our supplier, certification and authority communication runs in German
  • Experience in EV charging or e-mobility: OCPP, ISO 15118, Eichrecht, smart charging
  • Familiarity with embedded Linux (Yocto), EVerest or other open source involvement, Rust or modern C++
  • Experience working with contract manufacturers and owning production or end-of-line testing
  • Experience managing multi-generation products (legacy fleet plus new platform in parallel)

    • Your Benefits 🪴
  • Flat hierarchies with efficient decision-making processes without red tape
  • The opportunity to play a key role in shaping the mobility revolution
  • Work on products that have a direct impact on the future of sustainable transportation
  • Be part of an international and dynamic team of more than 30 nationalities
  • Enjoy a flexible hybrid setup — choose how you want to split your time between our Munich office and working from home, with the possibility of workation within the EU, plus 30 vacation days
  • Regular company and team events outside of the office to disconnect from our computers and reconnect with colleagues on hikes, mountain e-bike tours, offsites and more
  • Personal and professional development through in-house Lunch & Learn sessions, collaborative knowledge sharing, as well as externally provided training, courses and conferences
  • Discounted access to Wellpass for comprehensive wellbeing support - enjoy fitness, wellness, and mindfulness options to help you stay balanced and energized

Staff Backend Engineer – Platform 

Join Apaleo and shape the future of hospitality tech 

Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure lets hoteliers customise their tech stack, automate routine work and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay. 

If you're driven by the idea of making hospitality smarter, more human and powered by cutting-edge technology, we'd love to hear from you. 

 

About the role 

You'll join our Platform team as an individual contributor working closely with our Principal Engineer, who leads Platform's technical direction. Platform owns infrastructure, developer experience and security foundations for the whole engineering org, so this is a high-ownership seat: you'll take on large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives and drive them from first analysis through to completion, with real autonomy over how you get there. 

We don't run a groomed backlog or sprint planning. We assign a big topic to someone who owns it end to end. If you thrive with structure handed to you, this isn't the role; if you love spotting the problem worth solving and driving it yourself, you'll fit right in. 

 

What you'll be up to 

  • Architecting and developing scalable, reliable and maintainable backend systems. 
  • Self-identifying and scoping problems and initiatives, not just executing assigned tickets: assessing impact, prioritisation and timing independently. 
  • Leading architectural decisions and design discussions with cross-team alignment. 
  • Driving large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives end to end, including coordination with multiple stakeholders. 
  • Mentoring engineers and driving technical excellence. 
  • Building and maintaining internal tools and infrastructure (AWS, Terraform) that empower teams to deliver faster and more reliably. 
  • Owning observability, logging and operational excellence to keep the platform highly available. 
  • Participating in on-call rotations and stepping in as a reliable problem solver during incidents. 
  • Proactively spotting where AI and automation can drive technical improvement. 

 

Some of the challenges waiting for you 

  • Solving horizontal write-scaling for our database (we already scale reads horizontally). 
  • Modernising our CI/CD pipeline for faster, more reliable delivery. 
  • Migrating our infrastructure-as-code fully from CloudFormation to Terraform, including the ability to recreate an Apaleo environment from scratch. 
  • Extracting and reworking common services (like shared schedulers) to get us ready for our next scale level. 

 

What you'll bring to the team 

  • 8+ years of backend development experience, including several years in a staff-level or technical leadership role. 
  • Strong engineering fundamentals that transfer across languages and cloud platforms: we care more about how you think than which stack you've used. 
  • A track record of owning large technical initiatives from ambiguity through to completion, ideally on a platform or infrastructure team rather than a pure product team. 
  • Experience designing and scaling distributed systems in cloud-native environments (AWS preferred; strong Azure fundamentals with genuine enthusiasm for the switch work just as well). 
  • Comfortable working with containerised services and infrastructure-as-code (Docker, Terraform; CloudFormation exposure is relevant given our current stack). 
  • Confidence writing your own unit and integration tests: we don't have a dedicated QA function. 
  • Fluent English. 

Nice to have 

  • Direct experience with C# (.NET), PostgreSQL, AWS and ECS/Kubernetes: a great fit, though not a hard requirement if your fundamentals are strong. 
  • Experience setting up infrastructure-as-code from scratch and working with it day to day, ideally with Terraform, including migrating or consolidating from other IaC approaches (like CloudFormation). 
  • Experience with Kafka or other event-driven and streaming systems (Azure Service Bus experience is a good transferable equivalent). 
  • Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT, Amazon CodeWhisperer) and a genuine interest in AI-driven engineering improvement. 
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, particularly for introducing new technology, like AI tooling, to other teams. 

 

What we offer 

Culture and growth 

  • A diverse and international team: work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities. 
  • Growth and development: 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and an evolving career framework. 
  • Autonomy and ownership: we empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly in an environment built on trust and transparency. 
  • Shape the future of hospitality tech: your work drives real impact from day one, at a fast-growing scale-up. 
  • Competitive and fair compensation, guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. 

 

Perks and lifestyle 

  • Flexible and remote work options: office, home or hybrid, based on what works for your role and team. 
  • A fully covered Deutschland Ticket for free public transport across Germany. 
  • Regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties and other offsite events. 
  • 30 days of paid holiday to fully disconnect, recharge and return inspired. 
  • An EGYM Wellpass membership giving access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios and wellness options. 

 

Where you'll work from 

This role is based in Munich, with hybrid working from our office there. We're also open to remote within Germany, or remote via an Employer of Record for candidates based outside in the EU/ Europe.

 

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data will be handled with the utmost care and in compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations. We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation.

  • eine Aufgabe, in der Kommunikation zählt: Wir übersetzen komplexe Themen in verständliche Sprache.

  • ein kleines, motiviertes Team und erfahrene Kolleg*innen, die dich begleiten – niemand bleibt mit seinen Fragen allein.

  • Schulungs- und Awareness-Formate entwickeln, die wirklich gelesen werden – von Microlearnings über die Intranet-Gestaltung bis zu Onboarding-Unterlagen.

  • unsere Awareness-Kampagnen und BCM-Übungen mitplanen, begleiten und auswerten: Was hat gewirkt, was wurde ignoriert, was machen wir beim nächsten Mal anders?

Your new team:

As an Implementation Specialist, you are right at the heart of our projects: You translate business requirements into robust technical tracking solutions, implement them, ensure their quality, and turn concepts into fully functioning digital analytics setups. You take full responsibility for digital analytics implementations from initial requirements through to go-live and act as a trusted advisor to our clients throughout the process.


What awaits you:

  • You analyze our clients’ requirements and translate business and analytics use cases into technically sound tracking and implementation concepts.
  • You develop and document tracking concepts, data models, and data layer requirements and align them with clients and developers.
  • You work with tag management systems, implement tracking and third-party tags, and ensure scalable data collection.
  • You conduct technical testing, debugging, and data validation and systematically investigate data quality issues.
  • You consider consent management, data protection, and technical requirements from the very beginning of the implementation process.
  • You work closely with Digital Analysts, Data Engineers, and Project Managers, acting as the technical interface between business and development.
  • You actively share your expertise within your team and help develop our standards, best practices, and ways of working.
  • Depending on the project, you may also support tool selection, architecture decisions, migrations, and the technical enablement of our clients.


What you can expect:

At FELD M, you won’t work within a traditional agency structure with rigid specializations. We bring together different disciplines and perspectives and see ourselves as The Data Collective.

You will have the opportunity to work with a diverse range of clients, industries, and technology setups while continuously expanding your expertise. We deliberately work independently of specific tools while bringing many years of expertise and strong partnerships with, among others, Google and Adobe. Our projects range from auditing and optimizing existing implementations to complete new implementations and migrations, as well as complex analytics and data setups.

You also won’t work in isolation: At FELD M, the close connection between business, analytics, and technology is at the core of what we do. This intersection is what makes the role particularly exciting.

What else? We believe in People First and Sustainable Pace. Taking responsibility and delivering high-quality work does not mean constantly operating at full speed. We want to do great work sustainably – together, with mutual support and room for different lifestyles.We are looking for people who are curious, take ownership, and enjoy sharing their expertise. We don’t see job descriptions as rigid checklists. Instead, we want to understand how your experience, interests, and strengths fit the role and what we need as a team.


What you bring along:

  • You don’t need to know every tool. What matters more is that you have a strong understanding of digital analytics and can quickly familiarize yourself with new technologies and setups.
  • Several years of professional experience in digital analytics, web analytics, tracking, or MarTech implementation
  • Strong knowledge of at least one tag management system
  • Experience designing and implementing data layers and tracking concepts
  • A solid understanding of client-side and server-side tracking, as well as their respective technical requirements and capabilities

  • Experience with testing and data validation of analytics implementations
  • An understanding of consent management, data protection, and the technical implications for tracking
  • The ability to explain technical concepts clearly to different stakeholders
  • A structured, analytical, and quality-oriented approach to your work
  • A genuine interest in taking ownership and not just analyzing technical challenges, but implementing solutions yourself
We look forward to meeting you!

About HOLY

  • HOLY is the soft drink revolution: With our powdered drinks HOLY Energy®, HOLY Hydration®, HOLY Iced Tea®, HOLY Milkshake® and HOLY Syrup Bottle® you get amazing taste across 50+ flavors while maintaining a good conscience—for your body & the environment.
  • Over 2M loyal customers: Started in a shared apartment by three best friends, we have scaled to Europe's fastest growing consumer brand—and our cult-like community, the HOLY Squad, loves it: 4.6 stars on reviews.io speak for themselves.
  • From D2C to Global Omnichannel: In less than four years, we've profitably scaled HOLY to more than €180M D2C revenue in DACH, FR, UK and PL. Now scaling our retail business, we're on an exciting transition to becoming a true omnichannel rocketship.
  • We are still just getting started: Backed by the world's best consumer investors, we aim to revolutionize the soft drink industry and build a generational love brand: tastier, healthier & more sustainable. Our team of 170+ people aims high (Coca-Cola, we're coming for you!).


About the Position

As Procurement Director, you will build one of HOLY's most important competitive advantages: a world-class supplier ecosystem that enables us to scale faster, improve margins and consistently deliver outstanding products to our customers.

Procurement at HOLY is far more than buying ingredients. You will own our sourcing strategy across ingredients, packaging, merchandising and co-manufacturing while continuously improving cost, quality, supplier performance, flexibility and speed.

This is a highly strategic leadership position reporting directly to our COO, Markus. You will work closely with Product Development, Supply Chain Planning, Operations, Finance and our founders to build supplier partnerships capable of supporting HOLY's ambitious growth journey toward becoming a global consumer brand.

We are not necessarily looking for a traditional procurement leader. We are looking for an exceptional builder with outstanding commercial judgment who enjoys solving complex business problems and creating long-term competitive advantages.

If you combine strategic thinking with a hands-on mindset, thrive in fast-paced environments and enjoy building things from scratch, this role is for you.

Responsibilities: 

Strategic procurement

  • Own HOLY's sourcing strategy across ingredients, packaging, merchandising and co-manufacturing
  • Develop category strategies that improve competitiveness, resilience and long-term scalability
  • Drive structural COGS improvements through strategic sourcing, commercial excellence and value engineering
  • Identify new sourcing opportunities, technologies and supplier capabilities to strengthen HOLY's competitive position
  • Build long-term strategic partnerships with HOLY's key suppliers
  • Develop suppliers across capacity, quality, innovation, flexibility and operational excellence
  • Ensure our suppliers scale alongside HOLY's ambitious growth plans
  • Establish HOLY as a preferred customer through trust, transparency and professional supplier management
  • Strengthen our supplier ecosystem through selective onboarding of new partners and pragmatic multi-sourcing where it creates value
Supply Chain & Operational Excellence
  • Improve end-to-end supply chain performance by reducing lead times, increasing supplier responsiveness and improving planning reliability
  • Partner closely with Supply Chain Planning and Operations to align supplier capabilities with demand forecasts, inventory targets and growth plans
  • Improve working capital through stronger commercial terms, better supplier collaboration and optimized replenishment models
  • Support the development of a scalable and resilient manufacturing network
Supplier Performance & Quality
  • Own supplier performance across quality, OTIF, responsiveness, compliance and continuous improvement
  • Establish structured Supplier Business Reviews, measurable KPIs and clear accountability with strategic suppliers
  • Proactively identify and mitigate supply risks before they impact the business
  • Ensure suppliers consistently meet HOLY's quality, food safety and regulatory standards
Leadership & Organization Building
  • Lead and develop HOLY's Strategic Procurement and Operational Buying teams
  • Build a high-performance organization with strong commercial capabilities, clear ownership and a continuous improvement mindset
  • Develop future leaders and continuously raise the maturity of HOLY's procurement function
  • Build scalable processes, systems and ways of working that support HOLY's growth


About You

We care more about your ability to solve complex business problems than about having followed a traditional career path.

You might come from Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, Supply Chain, Operations, Strategy Consulting, Commercial or another highly analytical business function.

Ideally, you bring several of the following experience & expertise:

  • 5–10+ years of experience in Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, Consulting, Operations, Supply Chain, Commercial or another analytical leadership role
  • Outstanding structured problem-solving skills and the ability to translate complex challenges into pragmatic solutions
  • Strong track record of leading and developing teams 
  • Experience working in fast-paced, high-growth or entrepreneurial environments where ownership and speed matter
  • Strong commercial judgment and experience negotiating with suppliers, partners or senior stakeholders
  • Proven ability to drive cross-functional initiatives and deliver measurable business impact
  • Experience building scalable processes, organizations and ways of working
  • Exposure to manufacturing, FMCG, food & beverage or consumer goods is beneficial but not required
  • Excellent communication skills in English (German is a plus but not required) 
Mindset & Qualities: 
  • You are a builder who enjoys creating structures, teams and processes from scratch
  • You combine strategic thinking with strong execution skills and are comfortable getting hands-on
  • You have exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities and can quickly structure complex situations
  • You take ownership, move fast and thrive in environments with high autonomy and ambiguity
  • You build trust easily and can influence suppliers, stakeholders and teams through strong communication and judgment
  • You are commercially minded and always look for ways to create measurable business impact


Our Offering

In today's job market, A-players have many options to choose from. As part of our offer, we prioritise providing a productive working environment and opportunities for growth. In addition to competitive compensation, including company shares, you can expect:

  • A successful and growing company: Join a company that has been growing profitable and quickly for the last 36+ months and have raised a series B, while many other e-commerce companies are struggling.
  • Huge impact: Enjoy huge impact to shape HOLY’s internationalisation in a top market.
  • Awesome team: Join an awesome team of colleagues who are ambitious, funny, down-to-earth, and authentic. Get to know us and see for yourself!
  • Top product: Marketing is important, but a good product is essential. Our differentiated soft drinks have won over 2.5 million customers. Check out our reviews.io reviews or contact us for free samples.
  • Startup culture: Join a startup culture that values flat hierarchies, fast pace, and personal development. With us, you can make a real impact.
  • Perfect setup: Enjoy a perfect setup that includes all the requirements of a modern employer, such as a central office in Berlin Prenzlauerberg, flexible working hours, and much more.
  • Competitive comp. + equity: Join us at a pivotal stage of hypergrowth. We offer a strong salary and meaningful equity—giving you the chance to share in our current success and benefit from the massive upside as we scale.
  • How we support your growth: flexible hours, 28 vacation days, 30 work-from-abroad days, €1,500 learning budget, Urban Sports Club membership, public transport subsidy, and biannual 360° feedback tied to your compensation.
Find out more about HOLY and our team on our careers page.


The Process

As we are experiencing rapid growth and have ambitious plans, the optimal start date for the position is today. Nonetheless, we are prepared to patiently await the arrival of the ideal candidate, recognizing that quality ultimately yields the best results.

  1. Getting to know you: A 30-minute introductory conversation with Lutza, our Talent Acquisition Lead to get to know each other and discuss your experience, motivation and the role.
  2. Hiring Manager Interview: A deep-dive discussion with Markus, our COO about your experience, leadership style and how you approach complex business challenges.
  3. Case Study: You will receive a business case to demonstrate your strategic thinking, analytical approach and ability to solve real HOLY challenges.
  4. Advanced Discussion in our office, the HOLY Temple: Present and discuss your case with key stakeholders while getting to know our team and our way of working.
  5. Founder Interview: A final conversation with Fredi, one of HOLY's founders to ensure a strong mutual fit.
  6. Offer & Decision: If everything aligns, we will make you an offer and hopefully welcome you to the HOLY team.
Typically, this process takes around 2–3 weeks.

  • Maintain and continuously improve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for quality control and quality assurance processes.
