Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. We’re growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we’re looking for a a Senior Full-stack Engineer to join our engineering team. In Team Decide you'll focus on designing the distributed execution engine that runs customer workflows. You'll own critical systems end-to-end on a team where your decisions shape the product.

What You'll Do

  • Build and operate backend services in Python on AWS — Lambda functions, DynamoDB, Aurora, and event-driven pipelines that handle real production traffic. You'll leverage agentic AI tools as part of your daily workflow.

  • Work on exciting AI initiatives such as MCP servers, agentic co-pilot

  • Tackle hard backend problems — latency, reliability, and scalability are everyday concerns.

  • Own your systems end-to-end: from architecture and implementation to deployment, monitoring, and incident response.

  • Make key architectural decisions — you'll have real authority over how things are built, not just what gets built.

  • Raise the bar for the team through code reviews, mentoring, and improving our development tooling and processes.

  • Work directly with Product and Design to shape what we build next.

Requirements

  • At least 5 years of professional full-stack software engineering experience, with a proven track record of leading complex projects in a senior capacity (2+ years).

  • Deep expertise in React

  • Experience working with Design Systems to ensure a consistent UX among different parts of the product

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to align technical and non-technical stakeholders on a shared vision.

  • The ability to work in a hybrid model from our Berlin HQ, the London office, or the Iasi hub. Please note that relocation assistance is not provided for this role.

Ideal, But Not Required

  • Strong system design skills — you're comfortable making architectural trade-offs and defending them

  • AWS Serverless experience at scale (Lambda, SAM, CloudFormation, DynamoDB, Aurora…)

Our Offer

  • Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here.

  • Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo.

  • Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe.

  • Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package.

We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears.

About Us

Taktile enables financial institutions to transform into AI-native organizations that are increasingly powered by autonomous agents.

With our modular Agentic Decision Platform, customers combine AI agents, rules, relevant context, and human oversight to safely automate and optimize their decisions—approving more customers, reimbursing claims instantly, stopping fraud before it spreads, and financing every business worth funding.

Founded in 2020, Taktile powers millions of decisions daily for institutions including Mercury, Monzo, Faire, and Pleo.

With offices in New York, Berlin, London, São Paulo, and Iași, the company has raised $184M from Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Index Ventures, Tiger Global, Balderton Capital, and Y Combinator. Learn more at taktile.com.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to turn n8n's pricing and packaging into a deliberate, data-informed growth lever - one that scales revenue and adoption across our entire go-to-market, from our 1.5 million-strong community to global Enterprise accounts.

To do so, here's what you'll own:

BUILD THE ANALYTICAL FOUNDATION FOR PRICING

  • Build and own the model connecting unit economics, agent run cost, willingness-to-pay, gross margin, and customer value.

  • Maintain competitive and market intelligence so our pricing keeps pace with a category that's shifting fast.

  • Run pricing experiments and turn the results into documented, reusable learnings.

DESIGN OUR PRICING & PACKAGING ARCHITECTURE

  • Shape plan design and packaging across our community, self-serve, and Enterprise tiers, plus add-ons like our startup and charity plans.

  • Design pricing for new SKUs and consumption-based models as our product and cost-to-serve evolve around AI Assistant and n8n Connect.

  • Build packaging frameworks and decision tools that product teams use directly to launch new features.

DRIVE AND ROLL OUT PRICING DECISIONS

  • Lead cross-functional pricing decision-making and secure buy-in across Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance, RevOps, and Data.

  • Own the rollout of major pricing changes end-to-end, from decision to launch to measured impact.

  • Build and own our pricing frameworks: list pricing, discount guardrails, decision rubrics, grandfathering rules, and usage-based billing decisions.

Requirements

Must-have

  • 📈 Pricing leadership in B2B SaaS: You have 6+ years in pricing, monetisation, or commercial strategy, including at least one full cycle leading a major pricing model transition — subscription to consumption, seat-based to usage-based, or a platform repricing.

  • ⚡ Hands-on with modern pricing models: You've personally designed and rolled out consumption-based, outcome-based, or AI-native pricing at a company past $100M ARR.

  • 🔀 Both self-serve and Enterprise motions: You've owned pricing on both sides of the funnel — self-serve/PLG (activation, conversion, tier design, funnel experimentation) and Enterprise, sales-led (packaging for large accounts, deal economics, discount governance). n8n monetises both, so fluency in one motion only isn't enough.

  • 🧮 Deep analytical rigour: You build the financial model yourself and reason fluently about unit economics, cost-to-serve, gross margin, willingness-to-pay, and elasticity.

  • 🔌 Billing fluency, technical and operational: You understand event metering, rating, entitlements, proration, overage, and revenue recognition well enough to design pricing that's actually operable — and you've partnered with a Billing function on invoicing, dunning, true-ups, and disputes.

  • 🛠️ Empathy for technical users and buyers: You understand where, how, and why developers and technical buyers assign value across a product experience.

  • 🧩 Frameworks over bottlenecks: You've built packaging frameworks and decision tools that product teams use independently, rather than routing every pricing decision through you.

  • 🤝 Cross-functional influence: You bring Product, Finance, Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Billing into alignment on contentious commercial decisions.

  • 🧭 Motivated by scope, not headcount: You're energised by owning a global, high-stakes topic as an individual contributor, with analytical support from Data and RevOps and rollout support from Program Management.

Nice-to-have

  • 🎓 Formal pricing training: You've been trained at Simon-Kucher or the pricing practice of another consultancy, and you bring that rigour with you.

  • 🧑‍💻 Developer tools experience: You've priced products sold to engineers and technical teams.

  • 🌍 Open source or freemium background: You know how to design pricing that converts a free community into paying customers without breaking trust.

Why join us?

At n8n, pricing won't be an afterthought argued about in the margins of someone else's roadmap - it'll be your function to build. You'll be our first dedicated pricing hire, which means low-hanging fruit everywhere and real scope to shape how a $5.2bn company monetises across community, self-serve, and Enterprise, in 100+ countries and across both cloud and self-hosted. You'll work directly with leaders in Product, Sales, Finance, and RevOps, and you'll see your decisions land in our ARR in months, not years. You'll join a supportive, remote-first team that values autonomy, experimentation, and continuous learning.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now - and help us build the future of automation.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

Intro

Back problems are the most common cause of work incapacity in Germany.

Vivira has the solution: We provide digital movement therapy via app. Always available, simple, effective, and reimbursed by health insurance. Vivira was born out of the need to treat musculoskeletal conditions as simply and effectively as possible.


Your responsibilities include

As Senior Product Manager Digital Health (m/f/d), you play a central role in developing and expanding our existing digital therapy offering. 

You drive forward how we can support patients and physicians even better in treating and reducing musculoskeletal pain. Depending on your experience and current focus, you take ownership of a central product or growth area along our patient, therapy, or practice journey – acting as the interface between medical relevance, technical feasibility, regulatory requirements, and commercial success. 

You conceive, validate, and prioritize new product and service ideas and prepare them for implementation in a structured way. Your work lays the foundation for expanding our product and service portfolio, strengthens long-term customer relationships, and creates lasting value – beyond the actual therapy phase.


What you should bring

  • Experience: Several years of solid product management experience (typically 5+ years), e.g. as Senior, Lead, or Principal Product Manager or Product Owner, ideally in Digital Health, MedTech, DiGA, or similar fields. You have independently owned a digital product area and can show how your decisions changed user and business outcomes.
  • Outcome-driven product development: You steer by impact, not output – data-driven decisions come naturally to you.
  • Stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership: You communicate confidently with C-level, Engineering, Regulatory, and the clinical team.
  • Mindset: You bring strong empathy for the medical context, act proactively, and have a solution-oriented, hands-on mentality.
  • AI fluency: You use AI pragmatically in discovery, research, analysis, or prototyping and can judge where it accelerates product work – and where human judgement remains essential.
  • Language: Excellent German and English (C1 or above in both) – neither needs to be your native language.

Nice to have
  • Experience in Healthcare, Digital Health, HealthTech, MedTech, Pharma, Digital Therapeutics, or Clinical Software – ideally with direct DiGA experience and knowledge of the regulatory framework (DiGA, MDR).
  • Experience working with physicians, practice teams, medical assistants, patients, or other healthcare stakeholders.


What to expect at Vivira

  • Workplace: Work from home or from our centrally located Berlin HQ.
  • Working abroad: The option to work remotely for up to one month per year from the EU, EEA, Switzerland, Israel, or the UK.
  • Recharge: 30 vacation days – for real breaks and new energy.

  • Highlights: Several company and team events per year create exchange, fun, and a real sense of community.

data.description:
Es ist Feierabend und du verlässt das Office, happy und mit einem starken Gefühl. Dein erster Tag bei PRESCH war einfach stark 🔥

Du hast dir das Sortiment angesehen: über 500 aktive Artikel, vom Hammer bis zum Säbelsägeblatt, Lieferanten über halb Asien verteilt, Verkauf in mehr als zwanzig Länder. Und du hast sofort gesehen, wo das System noch fehlt. Nicht weil hier niemand hinschaut — sondern weil bisher niemand die Aufgabe hatte, aus einzelnen Prüfungen eine Systematik zu machen.

Genau das wird deine Aufgabe. Wir erweitern unsere Qualitätssicherung deutlich, weil wir immer mehr eigene Produkte entwickeln. Du bekommst keine fertige Struktur vorgesetzt, du entwirfst sie 💪

Und du merkst schnell: Hier wird nicht geredet, hier wird gemacht. Kurze Wege, direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung, Entscheidungen am selben Tag.

Aufgaben

🛠️ Du gibst frei — oder eben nicht. Vor jeder Verschiffung kommt ein Muster aus der laufenden Produktion zu dir. Du prüfst nach Maß, Werkstoff, Oberfläche und Funktion, dokumentierst das Ergebnis im Erstmusterprüfbericht und entscheidest, ob die Ware rausgeht. Ohne dein Ja bewegt sich nichts.

🛠️ Du baust die Prüfsystematik auf. Prüfvorschriften je Warengruppe und je Artikel, Stichprobenumfang und Annahmezahlen nach AQL, Freigabemuster als verbindlicher Vergleichsmaßstab, Rückverfolgbarkeit von jedem Befund zu Charge und Lieferant. Reproduzierbarkeit ist der Anspruch: Dieselbe Prüfung muss in zwei Jahren dasselbe Ergebnis liefern.

🛠️ Du prüfst nach, was tatsächlich angekommen ist. Wenn die Charge im Lager eintrifft, kommt ein Muster daraus zu dir und wird gegen das verwahrte Freigabemuster abgeglichen. Genau hier fallen die Fälle auf, in denen etwas anderes geliefert wurde als freigegeben. Denn nicht nur die erste Lieferung muss stimmen, sondern die zwanzigste auch.

🛠️ Du prüfst über das gesamte Sortiment. Handwerkzeug vom Hammer über Schraubendreher, Zangen und Schlüssel bis zu Messwerkzeug und Schutzausrüstung. Und Elektrowerkzeug-Zubehör: Bohrer, Bits, Säbelsägen-, Stichsägen- und Kreissägeblätter, Schleifmittel. Handwerkzeug beurteilst du statisch, Zubehör nur unter Last — mit definiertem Prüfwerkstoff und Abbruchkriterium, damit Standzeiten vergleichbar bleiben.

🛠️ Du machst Qualität messbar. Fehlerquoten je Lieferant, Warengruppe und Charge, Reklamations- und Rückläuferquoten je Artikel, qualitätsbezogene Lieferantenbewertung. Damit im Einkauf mit Zahlen entschieden wird und nicht mit Eindrücken.

🛠️ Du gehst Kundenfehlern auf den Grund. Reklamationen, Rückläufer und Produktbewertungen sind die schnellste Qualitätsmeldung, die wir bekommen — schneller als jeder Lieferantenbericht. Du liest sie als Befund, ordnest sie der Charge zu und schließst den Kreis zum Lieferanten.

🛠️ Du steuerst unsere externen Prüfinstitute. Wo eine Norm eine akkreditierte Prüfung verlangt — VPA, TÜV, VDE — holst du Angebote, beauftragst, verfolgst Termine und bewertest die Berichte. Du behältst den Überblick, welche Norm für welche Warengruppe gilt.

🛠️ Du richtest unsere Prüfwerkstatt ein. Prüfplätze, Messmittel, Prüfwerkstoffe, Prüfmittelverwaltung mit Kalibrierintervallen. Du entscheidest mit, mit welchem Equipment du arbeitest.

🛠️ Du arbeitest mit unserem QC-Officer in Asien zusammen. Er prüft vor Ort in den Werken, du bewertest seine Berichte und gibst die Prüfanforderungen vor. Zwei Kontrollpunkte, ein System.

Dein Impact nach 12 Monaten

🛠️ Es gibt eine Prüfsystematik, nach der auch jemand anderes prüfen könnte — mit Prüfvorschriften, AQL-Niveaus und Freigabemustern für die wichtigsten Warengruppen.

🛠️ Keine Sendung verlässt die Produktion ohne dokumentierte Freigabe. Und die Prüfung ist trotzdem kein Nadelöhr.

🛠️ Jeder Befund ist zu Charge, Lieferant und Produktionszeitraum zurückverfolgbar.

🛠️ Es gibt ein monatliches Qualitätsreporting, das im Einkauf tatsächlich benutzt wird.

🛠️ Reklamationen und Rückläufer sind messbar zurückgegangen, weil Fehler bei dir auffallen und nicht beim Kunden.

🛠️ Die Prüfwerkstatt steht, inklusive Verschleißprüfung unter Last.

Qualifikation

🛠️ Technische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung zum Techniker oder Meister, oder ein technisches Studium. Maschinenbau, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Qualitätsmanagement oder vergleichbar — die Richtung ist offener als du denkst, die Praxis zählt mehr als der Abschluss.

🛠️ Zwei bis fünf Jahre in Qualitätssicherung oder Qualitätsmanagement. Idealerweise in einem Unternehmen, das beschafft statt selbst fertigt, mit internationalen Lieferanten.

🛠️ Erstbemusterung, Prüfplanung und AQL sind für dich keine Abkürzungen, sondern Alltag. Du hast schon Erstmusterprüfberichte geschrieben und Annahmezahlen festgelegt.

🛠️ Du verstehst Werkzeug als Anwender. Du hast selbst gebohrt, gesägt und geschraubt und weißt, wie sich ein gutes Werkzeug anfühlt. Ohne das bleibt jede Beurteilung eine Zahl ohne Bedeutung.

🛠️ Reproduzierbarkeit ist dein Anspruch, nicht deine Pflicht. Du hältst fest, was du feststellst — Messwert, Bild, Bedingung, Urteil. Weil ein Befund nur dann etwas wert ist, wenn er sich in zwei Jahren noch nachvollziehen lässt.

🛠️ Du bleibst standfest. Eine Sperrung hält Ware auf, und dann wird es unbequem. Wer im Zweifel freigibt, um Ruhe zu haben, macht in dieser Rolle den teuersten Fehler.

🛠️ KI ist dein tägliches Werkzeug. Wir arbeiten damit im ganzen Unternehmen. Wenn du damit schon Auswertungen, Vorlagen oder Abläufe gebaut hast, passt du gut zu uns.

🛠️ Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch. Du sprichst direkt mit unseren Herstellern und liest Prüfberichte im Original.

Bonus: Erfahrung mit asiatischen Lieferanten. Erfahrung mit Messmitteln wie Messschieber, Härteprüfung oder Drehmomentprüfung. Kenntnis der Normen für Werkzeug und Elektrowerkzeug-Zubehör. Erfahrung mit Verschleiß- und Standzeitprüfungen. Erfahrung im Aufbau eines QM-Systems oder einer Prüfstelle. Und wenn du eine Prüfvorschrift oder ein Prüfkonzept mitbringst, das du selbst geschrieben hast — zeig es uns. Wir wollen sehen, wie du denkst, nicht nur was im CV steht.

Benefits

🛠️ Du baust die Funktion auf, nicht nur den Prüfplatz. Prüfsystematik, Kennzahlen, Lieferantenbewertung, Prüfwerkstatt — du entscheidest, wie Qualität bei PRESCH funktioniert. Bei weiterem Wachstum wird daraus ein eigener Bereich mit Team.

🛠️ Direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung. Kein Konzern-Reporting, keine Zwischenebene. Du berichtest direkt und bekommst Entscheidungen am selben Tag.

🛠️ Deine Freigabe hat Gewicht. Ohne dein Ja geht keine Ware raus. Das ist Verantwortung, die man nicht in jeder Qualitätsstelle bekommt.

🛠️ Gleitzeit. Du willst Job und Familie die gleiche Zeit widmen und sehnst dich daher nach einem flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodell? Kein Problem! Wir integrieren die Arbeit in unser Leben und nicht andersherum.

🛠️ Homeoffice-Tage für die Schreibtischanteile deiner Arbeit — Auswertungen, Prüfvorschriften, Reporting. Geprüft wird vor Ort, alles andere in Absprache mit dem Team.

🛠️ Du willst dich weiterentwickeln — Qualitätsmanagement, Messtechnik, Normenwissen, Auditorenqualifikation? Alles klar, dann los! Wir legen großen Wert auf deine Weiterbildung und schaffen den finanziellen und zeitlichen Rahmen dafür.

🛠️ Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit unserem Zuschuss.

🛠️ 30 Tage Urlaub.

🛠️ Mitarbeiterrabatt auf unser komplettes Werkzeugsortiment.

🛠️ Unsere Hierarchien sind flach, der Zusammenhalt ist groß: Wir feiern unseren Erfolg. Wissensaustausch, Glühweinabende, BBQ und regelmäßige Teamevents erwarten dich bei uns. Getränke sind selbstverständlich dabei.

🛠️ Du bist in alle Geschehnisse unseres jungen und wachsenden Unternehmens einbezogen und führst deine eigenen Projekte.

Wenn du Qualitätssicherung nicht verwalten, sondern aufbauen willst — dann freuen wir uns auf dich!

data.description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

Camunda's Revenue Operations organization is looking for a Senior GTM Systems AI and Automation Engineer to design, build and operate the AI-powered infrastructure that connects our go-to-market systems and removes manual work across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Partnerships and Account Development. You will join the GTM Systems team – a small group of builders who own a Salesforce-centric revenue stack – and take ownership of its AI and automation layer: agents, LLM integrations, MCP servers, retrieval pipelines, backend services and workflow orchestration. You will partner with GTM leaders to find high-impact problems, scope them, and ship reliable, well-governed solutions iteratively. This is a fully remote role and can be based anywhere we are eligible to hire.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build and operate AI agents, LLM integrations and automations that connect Salesforce, Gainsight, Slack, Salesloft, Clari, HubSpot, Impartner and the rest of the GTM stack – reducing manual work across Sales, CS, Marketing, Partners and ADR teams.

  • Own the architecture of the GTM Systems AI layer: MCP servers, APIs, retrieval and context pipelines, reusable agent tools and skills, and serverless or containerized services on Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions).

  • Ship production-grade LLM capabilities – prompt engineering, RAG, function calling, structured outputs, automated evaluations – with the guardrails to match: validation, fallback logic, confidence thresholds, human escalation paths, access controls, audit logging, and cost and latency management.

  • Partner with Revenue Operations, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Partnerships and SDR/ADR leaders to identify and prioritize automation opportunities, translate ambiguous requirements into maintainable solutions, and deliver incrementally with clear documentation.

  • Raise the engineering bar for the GTM Systems team: code review, automated testing, CI/CD, security governance, observability and technical documentation; mentor teammates on responsible AI-assisted development.

  • Design and deploy workflows on orchestration platforms such as Camunda and Clay, and create playbooks and enablement so GTM teams can use and operate automations independently.

What You Will Bring to the Role:

Must Haves:

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience (backend development, systems integration, data or analytics engineering, or automation), including at least 2 years shipping LLM or AI capabilities into production business workflows or internal tools.

  • Strong proficiency in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript (Node.js), with mature Git-based development habits: code review, automated testing, CI/CD.

  • Hands-on command of LLM patterns – prompt engineering, RAG, function/tool calling, structured outputs, model evaluation – and of their failure modes and mitigations (validation, fallback logic, confidence thresholds, human review, cost and latency control).

  • Experience integrating with Salesforce (REST/Bulk/Streaming APIs, data model, platform limits; Apex or Flow a plus) and other business systems via APIs and event-driven patterns, and with a cloud platform (GCP preferred: BigQuery, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, IAM).

  • Ability to own a problem end-to-end with minimal guidance – scope, design, deliver, operate – and to communicate clearly with engineering and business stakeholders in a remote, asynchronous environment.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar standards for connecting AI systems to tools and data; agent frameworks; vector databases or retrieval pipelines (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB).

  • Exposure to AI observability and evaluation tooling (LangSmith, Weights & Biases, or custom eval frameworks).

  • Familiarity with orchestration platforms such as Camunda or Clay, and prior work in Revenue Operations, GTM Systems, Sales Operations or Marketing Operations in B2B SaaS.

  • Building lightweight interfaces for AI tools (React, Slack Block Kit, dashboards); Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II, Integration Architect).

This role is an existing vacancy

What We Have to Offer:

Compensation

We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.

The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills, experience, and location, and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth:

  • United States: $143,800.00 to $231,900.00

  • United Kingdom: £90,300.00 to £148,500.00

  • Singapore: S$178,600.00 to S$267,900.00

If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.

  • Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!

AI in our hiring process: Camunda may use AI tools to aid the screening of applications and during the interview process. You can learn more here

”Everyone is welcome at Camunda” — it’s a celebrated component of our culture. We strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our people. At Camunda, we honour diverse cultures and backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristics under applicable law. We are looking forward to your application!

Come join us and be part of Camunda’s incredible journey: Make an impact at a pivotal moment in our story!

Please be aware that scammers may impersonate Camunda by reaching out about job opportunities. Camunda will only contact candidates from an email address ending in @camunda.com. We will never ask candidates for bank account details, checks, payment, or other sensitive financial information as part of our hiring process. If you receive a suspicious message, please do not respond, click any links, or share personal information.

Note for recruiting and placement agencies: Camunda does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our careers site, employees, or any other Camunda contact unless we have specifically engaged your firm for that search. data.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation.

We are looking for an Avionics Systems Engineer to support the design, development, integration, and validation of spacecraft avionics systems. The role focuses on delivering robust and reliable electronic systems for data handling, communications, and control across all mission phases.

The engineer will contribute to system architecture definition, interface management, verification activities, and requirements engineering, while working closely with multidisciplinary teams and external stakeholders. In this role, you might be assigned to different avionics systems of the spacecraft.

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture

  • Define and develop avionics system architectures, including electronics, data handling, and communication functions.

  • Ensure end-to-end consistency of data flows, interfaces, and system-level requirements.

  • Support selection and definition of avionics equipment, computing platforms, sensors, and communication hardware.

  • Contribute to spacecraft-level trade-offs between performance, reliability, mass, power, and cost.

Communications & Data Handling

  • Define onboard and ground-related communication and data handling concepts.

  • Support implementation of telemetry, telecommand, and data distribution architectures.

  • Ensure reliable data acquisition, processing, storage, and transmission under mission constraints.

  • Contribute to bandwidth, timing, and data budget analyses.

Integration & Interface Management

  • Define and manage interfaces between avionics and other spacecraft subsystems (power, propulsion, GNC, payload, etc.).

  • Ensure compatibility between spacecraft, launch vehicle, and ground segment interfaces.

  • Coordinate interface definitions with internal teams, suppliers, and external stakeholders.

External Regulatory & Certification Leadership

Strong ability to technically present, defend, and substantiate avionics subsystem designs and verification evidence with external regulatory and certification authorities, including NASA, ESA, and other government agencies, supporting spacecraft qualification, safety, and flight certification.

Verification & Validation

  • Define and support verification and validation strategies for avionics systems.

  • Participate in simulation, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), and system-level testing activities.

  • Analyze test results, identify anomalies, and drive corrective actions.

  • Ensure compliance with system performance and reliability requirements.

Requirements Engineering

  • Capture, analyze, and manage system and subsystem requirements.

  • Ensure full traceability from mission objectives to implementation and validation.

  • Contribute to system documentation, including specifications, interface control documents, and test plans.

  • Ensure compliance with applicable space standards and engineering best practices.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with software, hardware, systems, operations, and mission engineering teams.

  • Participate in design reviews, technical exchanges, and system trade-off discussions.

  • Support alignment with external partners, suppliers, and customers.

  • Contribute to integration campaigns, launch preparation, and mission operations support.

Required Qualifications

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, or equivalent.

  • +7 years experience in avionics systems, electronics, embedded systems, or spacecraft engineering.

  • Strong understanding of:

    • Electronic and embedded system architectures

    • Communication and data handling principles

    • System integration and interface management

  • Experience with requirements engineering and system lifecycle development.

  • Knowledge of verification and validation methods, including testing and simulation.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to work in multidisciplinary engineering environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in spacecraft avionics or aerospace systems.

  • Familiarity with space communication and data standards (e.g., CCSDS).

  • Experience with HIL testing, simulation environments, or digital engineering tools.

  • Exposure to safety-critical or mission-critical system development.

  • Experience working in international or multi-stakeholder engineering teams.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.  


All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible.

If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc.

Our mission is to enhance diagnostic precision and expand access to expert-level prostate cancer screening, ultimately improving patient outcomes worldwide.

Join our engineering team as a Full Stack Engineer and help build the next generation of medical imaging platforms. You'll work at the intersection of healthcare and technology, developing secure, scalable systems that directly impact patient care and clinical workflows.

You'll design and implement robust distributed systems that power our AI diagnostic tools—architecting services that handle sensitive medical data reliably, scale gracefully under load, and integrate seamlessly with hospital infrastructure.

What You'll Build

  • Scalable microservices architectures using Kubernetes for orchestration and deployment

  • Event-driven systems with RabbitMQ for reliable asynchronous processing of medical data

  • 3+ years of full-stack engineering experience with shipped products that real users depend on

  • Backend proficiency in Python with Flask or FastAPI for building reliable APIs and services

  • Database expertise in SQL and relational data modeling for handling complex medical data

  • Experience with message queues and event-driven architecture patterns

  • Clear communication skills and a pragmatic approach to solving complex technical problems

Bonus Points

  • Experience in healthcare/medical software development

Why This Role Matters

Your work will directly contribute to advancing cancer care technology. Every system you build, every optimization you make, and every integration you design helps medical professionals provide better care to patients facing one of life's most challenging diagnoses.

Wir machen also Getränke, wie sie sein sollten. Jede Flasche enthält nur beste biologische Zutaten und unterstützt den fairen Handel. So wurden schon über 90 Sozialprojekte in Afrika, Lateinamerika und Asien durch den Lemonaid & ChariTea e.V. gefördert.
Wir suchen auf unserer Mission für unseren Limoladen eine:n Senior Brand Manager:in zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt. Diese Stelle ist zunächst auf 2 Jahre befristet, ggf. mit Option auf Verlängerung/Entfristung.

  • You talk to customers to uncover their needs and shape solutions they love
  • You define the product strategy to increase the addressable market and to potentially bringthe product to further countries
  • You ensure that all launch activities are tackled and transparently shared with partners and internally
  • You work together with home energy management partners to ensure seamless integration with a first focus on Germany
  • You work closely together with our technology, energy supply and hardware team to ensure a smooth end-to-end user experience
  • You align frequently with internal and external stakeholders and are the first contact person for eyond and our Home Energy Solutions

data.description:
Where Legal Leads. 

Drei Worte. Eine Überzeugung. Rechtsabteilungen sind nicht länger die Bremse im Unternehmen – sie sind der Hebel. Bei DiliTrust geben wir ihnen die Plattform, die diesem Anspruch gerecht wird: Verträge, Beteiligungen, Vorstandsarbeit und Legal AI – eine integrierte Suite für die gesamte Rechtsfunktion. Im Einsatz bei mehr als 3.000 Unternehmen in 64 Ländern, darunter führende Konzerne in Europa, Nordamerika und MEA. 

DACH ist unser nächster großer Wachstumsmarkt. Die Basis steht, jetzt skalieren wir. Du übernimmst ein eigenes Territory, baust deine Strategie eigenständig auf und entscheidest, wo du wachsen willst – unterstützt von einem Team aus Solution Consultants, BDR, Marketing und Customer Success, das in DACH bereits liefert. 

Der Legal-Tech-Markt ist über 16 Milliarden Dollar schwer und wächst jedes Jahr zweistellig. In zwei Jahren wirst du auf diesen Moment zurückblicken. 

Die Frage ist nur: Warst du dabei? 


Deine Rolle 
 

Du verantwortest ein eigenes Vertical in DACH, z.B. Financial Services, Energy, Manufacturing oder Pharma. Dein Fokus liegt auf Neukundengewinnung und gezieltem Cross-Sell in deinem bestehenden Portfolio. 

  • Du identifizierst und qualifizierst neue Opportunities, gemeinsam mit deinem BDR, über Anfragen, Marketing und gezielte Ansprache. 

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, nicht aus dem Bauch. Du baust deinen Territory Plan auf, entwickelst Account Plans für deine Top-Targets und treibst gemeinsam mit deinem BDR fokussierte Pod Sprints in deinem Vertical. 

  • Deine Deals liegen typischerweise zwischen 50.000 € und 200.000 € Jahresvolumen. Sales-Cycles dauern 4–9 Monate. Pro Deal sprichst du mit 4–7 Entscheidern: Legal, IT, Einkauf, Finance, manchmal Vorstand. 

  • Du verkaufst eine Plattform, kein Einzelprodukt. Erstgespräche führen oft Legal Ops Manager oder General Counsel. Deals über mehrere Module sind bei uns die Regel. 

  • Du repräsentierst DiliTrust auf den wichtigen Branchen-Events wie z.B. Legal Revolution oder LegalTech. Du führst dort die Gespräche, die später zu Pipeline werden. 


Must-have

  • 4+ Jahre Erfahrung im quotaverantwortlichen B2B-Software-Vertrieb, idealerweise im SaaS-Umfeld. 

  • Erfahrung in komplexen Sales-Cycles mit mehreren Entscheidern aus Legal, IT, Finance oder Procurement. 

  • Methodisches Arbeiten: Du qualifizierst sauber (z. B. mit MEDDPICC) und führst belastbare Forecasts. 

  • Erfahrung im Verkauf an C-Level-Entscheider. 

  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachen-Niveau, sehr gutes Englisch – unsere Unternehmenssprache ist Englisch. 


Nice-to-have

  • Erfahrung im Verkauf an Rechts-, Governance- oder Compliance-Funktionen. 

  • Du kennst die Welt regulierter Branchen - Financial Services, Energy, Healthcare oder Pharma. 

  • Du hast bereits eigenständig ein Territory aufgebaut – mit klarer Account-Strategie und nachhaltigem Pipeline-Aufbau. 

  • Du interessierst dich für KI im Unternehmenskontext  und kannst Kunden den Unterschied zwischen Hype und echtem Mehrwert erklären. 


Was wir dir bieten

  • Remote-First. Du arbeitest von zuhause oder in unseren Offices in München und Berlin - regelmäßige Team-Events bringen uns offline zusammen. 

  • Onboarding und Ramp-Up, das zu einem komplexen Produkt passt. Produkt, Branche und Methodik step by step - mit erfahrenen Teamkollegen, die dich auf Tempo bringen. 

  • Ehrliches Coaching, präsenter Sales Manager. Wir sind 7 Leute im DACH-Sales, keine Nummer in einer großen Maschine. Regelmäßige Einzelgespräche, gemeinsame Deal-Reviews. Wenn du gut bist, wird das gesehen. Wenn etwas hakt, wird darüber gesprochen. 

  • Karriereperspektive in einer Wachstumsregion. Senior AE, Enterprise AE, Team Lead DACH: wir bauen die Region aktiv aus, nicht ab. 

  • Internationales Setup, lokaler Fokus. Dein Spielfeld ist DACH, aber wenn dich die Lust auf Mailand, Madrid oder Mexico City packt, kannst du auch von dort arbeiten. 

  • 30 Tage Urlaub, Zulage für Heimarbeit und weitere Vorteile folgen in Kürze! 


Dein Weg zu uns

  1. Erstgespräch mit dem Recruiting-Team (30 Min, auf Englisch) – wir lernen uns kennen, klären gegenseitige Erwartungen. 

  1. Interview mit dem Sales Manager DACH (45 Min) – Deep Dive in deine Erfahrung, deine Methodik und Fit für die Rolle. 

  1. Interview mit dem Global Chief Sales Officer (45 Min) – Strategie, Karriereperspektive, Final-Check. 

  1. Kurzes Rollenspiel (45 Min) – eine realistische Sales-Situation, an der wir sehen, wie du arbeitest. Du bekommst Briefing und Vorbereitungszeit. 

Bist du bereit, bei uns einzusteigen?

Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf – wenn möglich auf Englisch – ein Anschreiben ist nicht erforderlich. Wenn du vorab Fragen hast: ----- oder sende eine LinkedIn-Nachricht an Fabian Pohl.

Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von allen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, Religion, sexueller Identität oder Behinderung.

Hinweis: Wir nutzen KI-gestützte Tools zur Vorauswahl von Bewerbungen. Die endgültige Entscheidung trifft immer ein Mensch.

data.description:
Sunday Natural is one of Germany’s fastest-growing natural health brands, and our eCommerce platform is growing with it – today it serves 7 million monthly active users, runs on €400k of AWS per year, and supports a development organization of 30+ engineers. Every one of those numbers has moved sharply upward in the last few years, and all of them will keep moving.

You would be our first dedicated in-house Senior DevOps Engineer – and the two biggest engineering projects of the next two years are yours to help define and drive: bringing our entire infrastructure under Terraform, and strengthening the scalability, security and compliance posture across our cloud environments.

Your role

  • You shape the infrastructure vision. How we run, deploy, monitor and scale is yours to define, propose and defend.

  • You work alongside our two external partners as the in-house technical counterpart – building the architecture and standards together, and bringing the deep platform knowledge back into the company. As the platform grows, taking the technical direction of that group is a natural next step, and one we would actively support.

  • You own our AWS spend – €400k a year that currently has no dedicated owner, including where it goes and how we bring it down.

  • You are the escalation point. When production is at risk, you decide.

  • You report directly to the Head of eCommerce Platforms, with direct access to leadership for the decisions that need it.

What you'll own

  • AWS infrastructure – EC2, RDS, Fargate, CloudFront, S3, IAM – plus Cloudflare, DNS and WAF

  • Security & compliance – DevSecOps practices, system audits, patching and access reviews, and GDPR-compliant data handling across every environment

  • Infrastructure as code – taking us from manually managed to fully Terraform-defined

  • Data layer – MySQL under production load: tuning, replication, and backups you have actually restored from

  • Cloud economics – a €350k annual AWS budget with real headroom for optimisation

  • Delivery for 30+ developers – Bitbucket Pipelines, environments, and how fast and safely code reaches production

  • Reliability at 7M MAU – monitoring, logging, alerting and incident response (New Relic, Sentry, CloudWatch, PagerDuty)

Your profile

  • 7+ years running production infrastructure, with deep hands-on AWS as the person accountable when it breaks

  • Security-conscious infrastructure operations – DevSecOps practices, system audits and access reviews, comfortable being accountable for GDPR-relevant data handling

  • Infrastructure as code at scale – Terraform as your default way of working, on an estate of comparable size

  • Deep Linux (Debian/Ubuntu) – you can trace a slow system from the kernel up and explain what you found

  • MySQL under real load – slow-query analysis, replication, indexing, tested recovery

  • Ownership of monitoring and incident response at scale – you have built the alerting that catches problems before customers report them, using tooling like New Relic, Datatog, etc. and run the on-call and post-incident process around it

  • Experience defining standards that other engineers work to, whether with in-house teams or external partners, and holding the line on them

Nice to have

  • PHP-FPM / Magento 2 performance tuning, or Varnish and Redis at scale

  • Cloud cost optimisation at six-figure annual spend

  • AWS architecture certification

  • Experience with SIEM tooling (e.g. Wazuh) or similar security monitoring

  • Background in direct-to-consumer eCommerce or other high-traffic system operations

Our stack

Magento 2 · PIM · PHP · MySQL · Redis · Varnish · Docker · AWS · Terraform · Bitbucket Pipelines · New Relic · Sentry · CloudWatch · PagerDuty · Cloudflare

What we offer

  • An appealing discount on all of our products – from essential oils to vitamins & nutrients

  • We offer 28 days of paid time off per year plus up to 5 days off between Christmas and New Year

  • The Urban Sports Club membership and either Swapfiets bike rental or a subsidy for the Deutschlandticket

  • We believe great things happen when we meet in person, which is why we embrace a hybrid model with one home office day per week – up to two depending on the area you are working in – and up to two weeks per year working from abroad

  • Receive various discounts of up to more than 50 percent on attractive brands such as Flaconi, Bosch, Apple or Expedia

  • You will be given real ownership and plenty of room for new initiatives, as well as the opportunity to contribute your expertise and implement your great ideas

  • We like to celebrate each other! Regular tea & office parties, Christmas and summer feasts and various influencer events such as Women's Day

We are looking forward to your application!

Sunday Natural emerged from a long-standing passion and research in the fields of health, healing, and personal growth. The lack of natural, high-quality products on the market was the original motivation for founding Sunday Natural in 2013. We aim to produce the products we ourselves would love to buy – as natural as possible, absolutely pure, free from any additives, and of the highest quality. In a strategic partnership with CVC, Sunday Natural is now one of Germany's most renowned quality manufacturers, with its own research and development department in Berlin. For the continuous improvement of our products, we collaborate with selected research institutes, scientists, therapists, farmers, and professional associations.

We take our ecological responsibility very seriously: that’s why the majority of our product range is vegan. We also take an innovative approach to packaging: most of our products are packaged in glass, making them almost entirely recyclable.

Our diverse team in Berlin consists of over 400 employees from more than 45 nationalities and continues to grow – but at a sustainable pace. Our goal is to foster a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive work environment with a diverse group of motivated, talented, and visionary team members.

We highly value equality of opportunity and inclusivity, and we would like to particularly encourage women and candidates from under-represented backgrounds to apply, even if you don’t match with 100% of the requirements.

data.description:
About You

You have a knack for solving intricate Software Development problems. You're driven by the idea of writing code that simplifies life for millions of users globally. You're committed to continuous learning and enjoy tackling new challenges. Pair programming, code reviews, and collaborative brainstorming with a team are activities you find fulfilling. You're eager to work alongside developers, prospective customers, account executives, product managers, data scientists, and data analysts. You're a disciplined professional who consistently delivers high-quality code that you take full ownership of, communicates technical solutions with clarity and empathy, and takes the initiative to streamline processes for your team and yourself.

About Us

Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built on a unique GPT-based architecture made specifically for commerce. Constructor's AI-first solutions make it easier for shoppers to discover products they want to buy and for ecommerce teams to deliver highly personalized experiences, from search, to recommendations, to AI Shopping Agents and everything in between. Optimizing specifically for ecommerce metrics like revenue, conversion rate and profit, Constructor generates consistent $10M+ lifts for some of the biggest brands in ecommerce, such as Sephora, Petco, Under Armour, home24, Birkenstock and The Very Group. Constructor is a U.S. based company that has been in the market since 2019. It was founded by Eli Finkelshteyn and Dan McCormick who still lead the company today.

We’re a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things.

About the Position

As a Software Engineer on the Prospect UI Solutions team, you will play a pivotal role in proving how Constructor will enhance the website discovery experiences for prospects. You’ll work closely with internal Engineering, Product and Sales stakeholders to seamlessly integrate prospective customer data with our services, supporting them to create an optimized and accurate product discovery demo.

In this role, you will:

  • Fuel our proprietary AI models: Write JavaScript code to collect data essential for training our AI.

  • Leverage Modern Tooling: Utilize AI as a tool to accelerate your fundamental capabilities and knowledge on how to solve problems with software; building solutions that you are proud to call your own

  • Seal the deal: Collaborate with Data Analysts and Account Executives to secure deals with prominent e-commerce brands.

  • Leverage your tech knowledge: Assist prospects in integrating their data and user interfaces with our services, focusing on ETL and front-end integrations.

  • Deliver excellence: Validate the data provided by prospects and ensure the quality of the results returned by our services.

  • Empower a sales force: Contribute to the development and scaling of demo infrastructure to enhance the demo capabilities of the Sales team.

  • Be a part of the answer: Assist Account Executives by addressing technical inquiries from prospects about our services.

  • Elevate the team: Provide support to your teammates through thoughtful code reviews and empathetic problem solving sessions.

  • Visualize brilliance: Develop dashboards and alerts using React, Redux, Node, Clickhouse and OpenSearch.

  • Innovate with purpose: Implement and test new features for our open-source JavaScript UI libraries and REST clients.

  • Collaborative contribution: Steer cross-team efforts to ensure our prospect's needs are at the forefront of our priorities, making you a key player in our strategic success.

  • Champion team culture: Actively foster our team’s sense of community by expanding our roster of Friday team-building games and promoting a culture of empathy, personal growth, and support for others.

This role is ideal for any Software Engineer passionate about search technology, customer-focused solutions, and collaborative development.

Requirements

  • A minimum of four years of professional experience or relevant academic experience

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

  • English on C1 level (CEFR) or higher

  • Being able to attend regular meetings with teammates between 1400 and 1800 UTC, with working hours ideally starting some time in the range of 0900 and 1200 UTC.

  • Strong foundation and experience with server-side and client-side programming languages

  • Enjoys interacting with customers and solving new problems daily

  • Able to pick up new technologies and design patterns quickly and loves learning them

  • Experience with building User Interfaces utilizing front-end frameworks like (but not limited to) React, Vue or Angular

  • Proven track record of building UIs with heavy consideration for friendly user experience

  • Experience with automated tests like (but not limited to) Cypress, Jest, or React Testing Library

  • Experience in JavaScript will be a strong asset for this role, but candidates with a proven Software Development background that demonstrate a willingness to quickly learn the language will also be considered

  • Nice to have - TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind, Storybook, Python and web scraping experience

Benefits

  • 🏝️ Unlimited vacation time - we strongly encourage all of our employees take at least 3 weeks per year

  • 🌎 Fully remote team - choose where you live

  • 🛋️ Work from home stipend! We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office

  • 💻 Apple laptops provided for new employees

  • 🧑‍🎓 Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year

  • 👪 Maternity & Paternity leave for qualified employees

  • 🧠 Work with smart people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact

  • 💵 This position has a base salary range between $80k and $120k USD. The offer varies on many factors including job related knowledge, skills, experience, and interview results.

  • 🎉 Regular team offsites to connect and collaborate

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Constructor

At Constructor.io we are committed to cultivating a work environment that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome individuals of all backgrounds and provide equal opportunities to all applicants regardless of their education, diversity of opinion, race, color, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status or affiliation in any other protected group.

Studies have shown that women and people of color may be less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every one of the qualifications listed. Our primary interest is in finding the best candidate for the job. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of our listed qualifications.

Your Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer (f/m/d) at LIQID, who will play a pivotal role in building and scaling data infrastructure that powers decision-making.

You will design scalable, high-performance data pipelines, ensure data integrity, and drive efficient data processing across the organization. Working closely with our Head of Data, Analytics Engineers, and cross-functional teams, you will develop robust data architectures, enhance data security, and implement best practices that empower data-driven decision-making at scale.

This is not a role where you preserve what already exists. It is a role where you build what comes next. As LIQID scales beyond €4 billion in assets under management, the demands on our data infrastructure are growing fast. You will have real ownership over how we meet that challenge, with the autonomy to propose solutions and the backing to ship them.

 

What will keep you challenged?

  • Design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines and storage solutions that ensure efficient, secure, and reliable data processing from source systems to our data warehouse

  • Develop and manage ETL/ELT workflows to integrate data from multiple sources, ensuring seamless ingestion, transformation, and availability

  • Implement and enforce data quality, validation, and monitoring processes to guarantee accuracy and integrity for analytics and operational use cases

  • Ensure data security and compliance by applying best practices and industry standards for handling sensitive information

  • Collaborate with analysts, product managers, and engineers to understand data needs and deliver solutions that unlock new insights

  • Continuously evaluate and integrate new technologies to improve scalability, performance, and future-proof LIQID’s data infrastructure


What you bring

  • Over 5 years of professional experience in data engineering, data architecture, or a similar data related role

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field

  • Strong proficiency in SQL, Python and ETL/ELT frameworks, with experience in data modelling, warehousing, and database management (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake, PostgreSQL)

  • Experience with cloud data platforms (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud) and modern data pipeline tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt)

  • Solid understanding of data modelling principles to meet data governance, security, and compliance best practices and ensure safe and scalable data operations

  • FinTech experience is a plus, but a strong interest in financial services and data-driven decision-making is essential

  • Experience using AI coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to speed up development and integrating them into standard workflows (code review, CI/CD), with the judgment to verify output, not just ship it.

  • Experience with data quality testing frameworks or rules-as-code approaches (e.g. dbt tests, Great Expectations) to catch issues before they hit production.

  • Experience with streaming/near-real-time pipelines (Kafka, Kinesis, or similar) is a plus.

  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken; German is a plus


What we offer

  • Diversity: Flat hierarchies and cultural openness make you an integral part of our diverse team of international talents from day one.

  • Flexibility: We don’t complicate your life. You’ll find the right balance with flexible work models, working hours, and remote work options. 28 days of vacation and two additional days off on December 24 and 31 ensure you have ample time to unwind.

  • Appreciation: You’ll help shape the future of digital wealth management with us in an innovative, multi-award-winning company on a growth trajectory, with high market relevance and plenty of space for your ideas.

  • Development: We support your personal and professional growth with an annual development budget of €1,500. Additionally, at the start of your tenure at LIQID, you’ll receive high-quality equipment, including a MacBook, headphones, and a display.

  • Smart Money: As a LIQIDian, you'll enjoy attractive terms for our investment strategies, a monthly lunch allowance, and exclusive discounts with various providers.

  • Well-being: Regional organic products keep you fit in the office, and our health initiatives or Health Assistance Program go far beyond that.


What happens next

An excellent candidate, experience and transparency are our top priorities in the interview process. The different stages help us understand how a potential collaboration could look.

  1. Initial Call with our Talent Partner: A casual introduction and discussion to align your expectations with the role.

  2. Video Interview with Head of Data: You will learn more about the performance expectations and specific role requirements from our leadership team.

  3. Technical Assessment with two Senior Team Members: A technical exchange to discuss your experience and expertise in relation to the role.

  4. In-Person Meeting: You will meet some team members onsite, tour our office and sit down with our CTO.


About us

We are LIQID, one of the fastest-growing fintechs in Europe. Our purpose is to provide creators, entrepreneurs, and thinkers shaping our future with access to the same opportunities as the world’s most successful investors while balancing the demands of people, planet, and profit.

We offer our clients financial peace of mind through exceptional, curated investment solutions – ranging from the world’s best private equity and venture funds to award-winning wealth management solutions. All delivered via an intuitive digital experience with outstanding personal support. With over €3.5 billion in assets, we are backed by leading investors from the digital, private equity, and wealth management space, including LGT, Toscafund, HQ Trust, and Project A.

 

LIQID is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, age, religion, gender, ethnicity, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by equal opportunity laws.

At Quantum Systems, we are redefining the boundaries of autonomous drone technology. We develop and deploy some of the world’s most advanced UAVs, combining highly integrated hardware, embedded software, sensors, compute platforms, and production processes into reliable systems for demanding real-world missions.​

As part of our Software Production Support Team, you will work at the intersection of serial UAV production, embedded software, firmware deployment, production diagnostics, automation, and traceability. You will help ensure that every drone leaving production is equipped with the correct software, firmware, configuration, and documentation needed for safe and reliable operation.​

Between hands-on troubleshooting on the production floor, flashing microcontrollers and compute modules, analyzing system behavior, improving diagnostic workflows, developing production tools, and refining digital work instructions, you will play a key role in turning advanced UAV technology into stable, scalable, and efficient serial production



What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Leading and developing the Software Production Support team​.

  • Prioritizing urgent production support topics and long-term improvement activities​.

  • Identifying bottlenecks, recurring issues, and process weaknesses in serial production​.

  • Defining robust processes for microcontroller flashing, NVIDIA Orin installation, firmware updates, diagnostics, and recovery workflows​.

  • Driving automation and standardization of software-related production steps​.

  • Ensuring that production tools are reliable, versioned, documented, and maintainable​.

  • Defining requirements for production traceability and digital paper trail documentation​.

  • Coordinating software-related production escalations with Engineering, Quality, and Industrialization​.

  • Ensuring that Operations1 work instructions are technically correct and reflect the real production process​.

  • Monitoring KPIs such as production downtime, flashing success rate, recurring issues, and software-related first-pass yield​.

  • Turning production issues into sustainable process, tooling, or engineering improvements.



What you bring to the team:

  • Several years of experience in embedded systems, production software, manufacturing test, industrialization, or technical production support​.

  • Experience in serial production or manufacturing environments​.

  • Strong understanding of embedded software, firmware flashing, production diagnostics, and system integration​.

  • Experience with Linux-based embedded systems, ideally NVIDIA Jetson / Orin or similar platforms​.

  • Hands-on experience with scripting, automation, production tooling, and diagnostic workflows​.

  • Ability to analyze complex issues across software, electronics, tooling, process, and operator interaction​.

  • Experience coordinating or leading technical teams​.

  • Strong communication skills across production operators, engineers, quality teams, and management​.

  • A structured, hands-on mindset with the ability to distinguish one-off production issues from systemic process weaknesses​.

  • Ideally, experience in drones, robotics, aerospace, automotive, defense, or industrial electronics​.

  • Ideally, knowledge of CAN, UART, Ethernet, USB, SWD, JTAG, I2C, SPI, MES, ERP, traceability systems, or Operations1.


Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

  • We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.


Our benefits:

  • Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

  • Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

  • Mobile working: If it gets too turbulent for you in our office, you can get the necessary balance through mobile working.

  • Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy.

  • Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

  • Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.

  • Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.

  • Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Pasing in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.


About us:

Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors.


Our commitment:

We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success.

At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.

data.description:
About the team

The Value Proposition & New Benefits team owns what our core value proposition for subscription should be, and the new benefits that bring it to life. We sit within the wider Subscription EMEA org, whose vision is to create the world's leading membership programme in local commerce, delivering unprecedented value and a world-class experience to members.

About the role

We're looking for a Strategy & Operations Manager to own strategy and execution for new benefits within Subscription. This is a hybrid strategy/build/run role: you'll define what to launch, then work cross-functionally to get it shipped and measure whether it's working. You'll be expected to move fluidly between strategic thinking and hands-on execution - this is not a role where strategy stops at a slide deck.

Typical problems you'll solve:

  • What new benefits should we launch for Subscription - which ideas are worth pursuing, and what's the business case for each?

  • How do we prioritise and sequence a pipeline of benefit ideas against limited engineering, design, and operational capacity?

  • How do we define success for a new benefit before launch - what does a good outcome look like, and what would tell us to kill it?

  • Once live, how is a benefit actually performing - impact on acquisition, retention, frequency, and member satisfaction - against its cost to serve, and what does that tell us to do next?

  • How do we take a benefit from a small pilot to a scaled, steady-state feature, and what needs to be true operationally for that to work?

What you'll be doing

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for new benefits within Subscription - build the analysis, the business case, and the plan, and drive it through to execution.

  • Cross-functional delivery - partner with Product, Engineering, Design, Data Science, Marketing, and Finance to take benefit ideas from concept to launch, without formal authority over any of them.

  • Build and prioritise the benefit pipeline - evaluate a stream of ideas (experiential, use-case specific, or otherwise), size their potential impact and cost, and decide what's worth building next.

  • Track ongoing performance - maintain visibility into each live benefit's impact on acquisition, retention, frequency, and satisfaction against its cost to serve, flagging when something needs attention.

  • Scale what works - take benefits from small pilots to steady-state features, defining the operating model, reporting cadence, and processes needed to run them sustainably.

  • Bring outside-in perspective - track what Uber One, DashPass, Wolt+, Just Eat and Amazon Prime are doing with membership benefits, and translate what's relevant into Deliveroo's context.

  • Communicate to senior stakeholders - write clear strategy documents and present recommendations, trade-offs, and results to leadership.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in strategy & operations, strategy consulting, or business operations - ideally with exposure to marketplaces, subscription/membership businesses, or consumer tech.

  • Commercial acumen: strong understanding of marketplace dynamics and subscriber value; comfortable building a business case and owning a set of P&L-adjacent metrics.

  • Analytical rigor: comfortable interpreting data and experiment results to make a clear business call - you'll partner with Data Science on the "how" and "so what."

  • Bias for action and ownership: able to bring structure and clarity to ambiguous problems ("what should we build, and how will we know it worked?"), and to drive execution personally rather than just recommend.

  • Cross-functional influence: track record of aligning senior stakeholders and diverse functions (Product, Eng, Finance, Marketing) around a shared plan in a fast-moving, matrixed environment.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication - able to distill complex trade-offs into a clear recommendation for leadership.

Why Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. About the Team

Merchant EMEA Engineering builds the technology that helps merchants join, grow, and operate successfully across our markets.

Our organization brings together the strengths of Wolt and Deliveroo and supports merchants across 37 countries. We work across the merchant journey, including onboarding, business growth and support, analytics and recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, and merchant applications.

Our teams sit close to the business. Rather than primarily building foundational platforms, we build products and features on top of our existing platforms to solve real merchant and market needs, including local business requirements, growth opportunities, and operational challenges.

📍This open role is based in our tech hubs in London.

What You'll Do

As a Senior Fullstack Engineer, you'll own complex product and technical problems across the merchant experience, from problem definition through design, implementation, production, and ongoing evolution.

You'll:

  • Design, build, and operate production systems across backend services and user-facing applications.

  • Lead technically complex initiatives across areas such as merchant onboarding, analytics, recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, or merchant-facing tools.

  • Translate ambiguous business and merchant problems into scalable, pragmatic technical solutions.

  • Drive technical design and architecture decisions, considering scalability, reliability, maintainability, and long-term product needs.

  • Own systems and initiatives end-to-end, from early discovery and design through implementation, rollout, production operations, and iteration.

  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, operations, and engineers across teams to align on solutions and delivery.

  • Support and mentor other engineers through design discussions, code reviews, knowledge sharing, and technical guidance.

  • Use AI-assisted development tools effectively to increase engineering velocity, while maintaining strong judgment around correctness, security, maintainability, and quality.

  • Work comfortably outside your primary area of expertise when needed to solve problems end-to-end.

 

How We Work

  • Ownership: Senior engineers take responsibility not only for implementation, but also for understanding the problem, shaping the solution, and ensuring it works successfully in production.

  • Collaboration: We work closely across engineering, product, design, data, and operations. Senior engineers are expected to help drive alignment when problems span multiple teams or areas.

  • Pragmatism: We value simple and maintainable solutions that create business impact without unnecessary complexity.

  • Flexibility: We care more about solving the problem than strict frontend or backend boundaries.

Our Tech Stack

Our backend services primarily use Go and Kotlin, while our frontend applications use technologies such as TypeScript and React.

We also work with technologies including Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, gRPC, and modern cloud infrastructure.

Our Humble Expectations

We're looking for engineers who have:

  • An AI-first mindset, with strong experience leveraging modern AI tools alongside solid engineering principles to solve problems end-to-end, independently of any specific technology stack.

  • Strong experience designing, building, and operating production software at scale in backend, frontend, or fullstack environments.

  • Experience owning complex features, services, or technical initiatives from problem definition through production and ongoing operation.

  • Strong understanding of system design, APIs, databases, distributed systems, testing, observability, and production reliability.

  • Experience making technical and architectural decisions where there are multiple valid approaches and meaningful trade-offs.

  • A track record of helping other engineers grow through mentoring, technical guidance, code reviews, or knowledge sharing.

  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience with a modern backend language such as Go, Kotlin, Java, and/or modern frontend technologies such as TypeScript and React.

 

You do not need to be equally strong in frontend and backend. We welcome different balances of experience. You might be primarily a backend engineer who is comfortable making frontend changes when needed, or a frontend-focused engineer who is happy to work with APIs and backend services.

What matters most is that you are comfortable working across boundaries to deliver the right solution.

Nice to Have

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be a plus:

  • Merchant-facing or internal operational tools.

  • Analytics, recommendations, or decisioning systems.

  • Grocery, retail, restaurants, logistics, or marketplace technology.

  • Integrations with external business systems.

  • Kafka or other streaming technologies.

  • Cloud infrastructure such as AWS, Kubernetes, or Docker.

Why Join Us?

You'll work on products that directly affect how merchants interact with Wolt Deliveroo and DoorDash across Europe.

The scope is broad and close to the business, giving you the opportunity to work on meaningful problems across different parts of the merchant journey while developing your skills across the stack.
